input.zh: 网页当前可见控件及用户目标。
input.en: Visible page controls and the user's goal.

decision.zh: Jev 在一次请求中选择操作和当前元素编号；只有填写文字时才交给小型文本模型。
decision.en: Jev selects an action and an indexed page element in one request; a small text model is used only for typing.

action.zh: 执行器重新校验目标后操作浏览器，并单独检查任务结果；仓库给出机票搜索示例，停在结果页，没有预订。
action.en: The executor rechecks the target, acts in the browser, then independently verifies the outcome. The flight example stops at results; it does not book.

boundary.zh: 仓库中的速度数据仅对应作者的样本任务，不能外推为通用成功率。
boundary.en: The repository's timing covers its own sample task, not general reliability.

input.zh: Agent 对话中的工具调用、结果和上下文。
input.en: Tool calls, results and surrounding context from an agent transcript.

decision.zh: 对每个可裁剪的调用分别问两个 Noul：调用还需保留吗、结果还需逐字保留吗。
decision.en: Two Noul questions per eligible call ask whether the call and its full result still matter.

action.zh: 按代码阈值保留、截短或移除调用与结果；用户和助手文本保持原样。
action.en: Code thresholds keep, truncate or remove call/result pairs while user and assistant text stays intact.

boundary.zh: 压缩可能丢失后来才变重要的证据；仓库的失败分支会抛错，由调用方决定回退。
boundary.en: Compaction can discard evidence needed later; on failure the library throws and leaves fallback to the caller.

input.zh: PDF、DOCX 或 PPTX 的页文本，以及自然语言分类规则。
input.en: Page text from PDF, DOCX or PPTX files plus natural-language category rules.

decision.zh: Jev 判断文档类别和合并文件中的文档边界。
decision.en: Jev predicts document categories and boundaries within a combined packet.

action.zh: 程序输出类别、页码范围、复核标记，并可导出拆分后的 PDF。
action.en: The program outputs categories, page ranges and review flags, and can export split PDFs.

boundary.zh: 文字提取可在本地完成，但 Jev 推理仍使用托管服务；复杂 OCR 是另一个可选步骤。
boundary.en: Text extraction may run locally, but Jev inference is hosted; difficult OCR is a separate optional step.

input.zh: PostgreSQL 表行和 SQL 中写下的自然语言条件。
input.en: PostgreSQL rows and a natural-language condition written in SQL.

decision.zh: 扩展按批次为每行提一个 Noul 问题，也提供 Choice 和 Score 函数。
decision.en: The extension batches one Noul question per row and also exposes Choice and Score functions.

action.zh: 把概率返回给 SQL，用 WHERE、排序和分组接入现有查询；会话内按行内容缓存。
action.en: Probabilities return to SQL for filtering, sorting and grouping, with session-level caching by row content.

boundary.zh: 每条被评估的行都可能发往外部 API；作者的延迟和成本数字是其环境中的测量。
boundary.en: Evaluated row data can leave for an external API; latency and cost figures are measurements from the author's environment.

input.zh: HTTP 请求的方法、URL、脱敏后的请求头及部分文本正文。
input.en: An HTTP request's method, URL, redacted headers and part of its text body.

decision.zh: 每条语义路由对应一个 Noul，所有描述在一次 Jev 调用中评估。
decision.en: Each semantic route becomes a Noul question; all descriptions are evaluated in one Jev call.

action.zh: 代码按注册顺序和阈值选处理器；未匹配则走常规回退。
action.en: Code picks the first registered route above its threshold and falls through when none match.

boundary.zh: 作者明确称其为实验，不建议把语义路由用作认证或授权边界。
boundary.en: The author calls this experimental and warns against using semantic routes for authentication or authorization.

input.zh: 编码 Agent 准备执行的工具调用、近期用户指令及已读内容。
input.en: A proposed coding-agent tool call, recent user instructions and content the agent read.

decision.zh: Score 评估风险，Noul 判断是否需批准、是否由用户请求以及是否受不可信内容诱导。
decision.en: A Score rates risk; Noul questions examine approval need, user intent and instructions planted in untrusted content.

action.zh: 项目代码按阈值输出 deny、ask 或 allow，并通过各宿主的 hook 接入。
action.en: Project code maps answers to deny, ask or allow and connects through host-specific hooks.

boundary.zh: 这是社区实现的判断层，不能替代宿主权限、人工审批或真实安全边界。
boundary.en: This community judgment layer does not replace host permissions, human approval or security boundaries.

input.zh: 一条客服工单。
input.en: One support ticket.

decision.zh: 一次请求并行提问：Choice 选部门，Score 评估业务影响，Noul 判断流失等信号。
decision.en: One request asks Choice for the department, Score for business impact and Noul for churn signals.

action.zh: 代码依据不同风险设置不同的路由阈值，并为不匹配选项保留 other。
action.en: Code applies different routing thresholds by risk and keeps an other option for out-of-scope tickets.

boundary.zh: 这是可运行的示例工程；作者说明 OpenRouter 路径已运行，TypeSafe 直连路径尚未实测。
boundary.en: This is a runnable example; the author reports testing the OpenRouter path, not the direct TypeSafe path.

title.zh: 500 封邮件批量分类
title.en: 500-email classification demo

input.zh: 作者演示中的 500 封邮件。
input.en: The 500 emails in the author's demo.

decision.zh: 作者用 Jev 批量分类；原帖没有给出题型、分类标签或阈值。
decision.en: The author classifies the batch with Jev; the post does not disclose question types, labels or thresholds.

action.zh: 演示展示分类结果；作者自报耗时为数秒、成本为 3.5 美分。
action.en: The demo shows classifications; the author reports seconds of runtime and a 3.5-cent cost.

boundary.zh: 仅核对了作者原帖，未取得代码、邮件样本或独立计费记录。
boundary.en: Only the original post was checked; code, email samples and independent billing records were unavailable.

title.zh: 下载文件夹自动整理
title.en: Downloads folder sorter

input.zh: macOS 下载文件夹中的新文件和用户自定义规则。
input.en: New files in a macOS Downloads folder and user-defined rules.

decision.zh: 作者举例让 Jev 判断文件是否为发票；原帖未公开具体题型和字段。
decision.en: The author's example asks whether a file is an invoice; the post does not publish question types or fields.

action.zh: 应用按规则把文件移动到指定文件夹并更名；作者称未调用其他语言模型。
action.en: The app moves and renames files according to rules; the author says it uses no other language model.

boundary.zh: 仅为作者演示，源码、文件识别流程和误分类处理未从原帖核实。
boundary.en: This is an author demo; source code, file extraction and error handling were not verifiable from the post.

title.zh: 3,282 条 X 帖子分析
title.en: 3,282-post analysis

input.zh: 作者自己的 3,282 条 X 帖子及其表现数据。
input.en: The author's 3,282 X posts and their performance data.

decision.zh: 每条帖子回答八个关于主题、开头、语气和是否提供教学价值等问题；原帖未说明 Jev 题型。
decision.en: Eight questions per post cover topic, hook, tone and whether it teaches something; the post does not state Jev question types.

action.zh: 作者将判断结果与已有互动数据汇总，寻找高表现内容特征。
action.en: The author combines judgments with existing engagement data to identify patterns in better-performing posts.

boundary.zh: 样本只来自作者账户；成本与增长结论均为作者自报，不能推断因果或跨账号效果。
boundary.en: The sample is one account; cost and growth findings are self-reported and do not establish causality or cross-account performance.

input.zh: 历史 Hacker News 评论及其上下文。
input.en: Historical Hacker News comments and their context.

decision.zh: 首轮 Noul 判断评论是否预测未来；过阈值后，Noul、Choice 和 Score 判断可核对性、方向、主题与时间范围。
decision.en: A first-stage Noul judges whether a comment predicts the future; after a threshold, Noul, Choice and Score questions assess checkability, direction, subject and horizon.

action.zh: 代码筛选可事后核验的预测，记录结构化字段，并公布预注册千条评论试验的结果；全库处理尚未完成。
action.en: Code selects predictions for later hindsight grading, records structured fields and publishes results from a preregistered 1,000-comment pilot; the full archive has not been processed.

boundary.zh: 准确率、成本和校准数字是作者试验的自报结果；概率经另一步校准，整库规模与耗时仍属估计。
boundary.en: Accuracy, cost and calibration figures are reported by the author; probabilities need a separate calibration step, and full-archive scale and runtime remain projections.

input.zh: 用户在发送前写下的消息文本。
input.en: A message drafted before sending.

decision.zh: 一次 Jev 请求用 Choice、Noul 和 Score 判断整体语气、讽刺或催促等信号、紧急程度，以及是否适合发给经理。
decision.en: One Jev request uses Choice, Noul and Score to judge overall tone, signals such as sarcasm or pressure, urgency and whether the message suits a manager.

action.zh: 界面展示语气标签、颜色与措辞提示，由用户决定是否发送。
action.en: The interface shows a tone label, color and phrase tips; the user decides whether to send.

boundary.zh: 没有独立准确率测量；无 API Key 或请求失败时程序会切换到离线关键词判断，因此演示画面不能全部归因于 Jev。
boundary.en: There is no independent accuracy measurement; without an API key or on request failure the app uses an offline keyword classifier, so the entire demo cannot be attributed to Jev.

title.zh: JevSearch 网页搜索重排
title.en: JevSearch web reranking

input.zh: 用户查询、筛选准则，以及 Browserbase 搜索取得的约 25 个候选网页。
input.en: A user query, selection criteria and roughly 25 candidate pages returned by Browserbase search.

decision.zh: Jev 依据准则为候选结果打相关性分数。
decision.en: Jev scores candidate results against the selected relevance criteria.

action.zh: 程序返回得分较高的 5 个结果；作者称 Jev 有时会选出原始搜索前五之外的网页。
action.en: The program returns five higher-scoring results; the author says Jev sometimes selects pages outside the search engine's initial top five.

boundary.zh: 已核对作者原帖与 TypeSafe 转发推荐，但未找到公开代码、样本查询或独立相关性评测；不是 TypeSafe 官方项目。
boundary.en: The author post and TypeSafe's repost were checked, but no public code, sample queries or independent relevance evaluation was found. This is not a TypeSafe project.

input.zh: 基准合同与扫描件提取的 OCR 文本。
input.en: A baseline contract and OCR text extracted from a scanned copy.

decision.zh: 一次 Jev 调用以 Noul、Choice 和 Score 判断实质条款是否相符、有无可见修改、差异类型及条款接近程度。
decision.en: One Jev call uses Noul, Choice and Score to judge substantive term agreement, signs of edits, difference type and closeness of terms.

action.zh: 代码把答案汇成加权一致性分数；作者设置超过 90% 才通过，其余进入人工复审并形成可检查报告。
action.en: Code combines answers into a weighted consistency score; the author's policy passes above 90%, while other results go to human review in an inspectable report.

boundary.zh: 合同文本会送往 TypeSafe API；可选的问题生成功能还会调用 OpenAI。本站未独立调用 API 或验证法律结论；90% 是作者阈值，合同仍须人工核对原文。
boundary.en: Contract text goes to the TypeSafe API; optional question generation also calls OpenAI. This site did not run the API or validate legal conclusions. The 90% cutoff is the author's choice, and original terms still need human review.

title.zh: OpenRouter 用 Jev 选择模型
title.en: OpenRouter model selection with Jev

input.zh: 发往 OpenRouter 的 LLM 请求及会话上下文；原帖称路由会考虑缓存。
input.en: An incoming OpenRouter LLM request and conversation context; the author's post says routing is cache-aware.

decision.zh: Jev 判断任务、难度、精度需求和更大模型的收益，选择目标模型及推理强度。
decision.en: Jev judges task type, difficulty, precision needs and likely benefit from a larger model, then selects a model and reasoning effort.

action.zh: OpenRouter 将请求送到所选模型，并在响应中附路由依据；其原帖称 Jev 超时或返回无效内容时请求会失败。
action.en: OpenRouter forwards the request to the selected model and includes routing metadata; its post says a Jev timeout or invalid output fails the request.

boundary.zh: 已核对 OpenRouter 原帖、产品页和 TypeSafe 转发，未见公开路由源码或本站独立质量、成本评估；这是第三方产品，不能把官方转发当作 TypeSafe 一手项目。
boundary.en: The OpenRouter post, product page and TypeSafe repost were checked, but no public router source or independent quality and cost evaluation was found. This is a third-party product, not a TypeSafe first-party project.

title.zh: jevgrep 定位代码上下文
title.en: jevgrep code-context retrieval

input.zh: 编码任务问题、仓库目录、文件预览与源代码单元。
input.en: A coding-task question, repository hierarchy, file previews and source units.

decision.zh: Jev 逐层用封闭的是非判断筛出与任务相关的目录、文件和代码位置。
decision.en: Jev uses bounded yes-or-no relevance judgments to select folders, files and code locations across the repository hierarchy.

action.zh: CLI 返回带行号的原始代码片段和阅读线索，编码 Agent 再自行修改与测试。
action.en: The CLI returns verbatim source excerpts with line references and reading leads; the coding agent then edits and tests separately.

boundary.zh: 符合筛选条件的源代码会发往用户所选的外部 Jev 服务；仓库作者的成本和任务成功率仅为其样本结果，检索线索不保证完整。
boundary.en: Eligible source content is sent to the chosen external Jev provider. The author's cost and solve-rate figures apply only to their sample, and retrieval may miss relevant files.

title.zh: wellposed 检查 Jev 请求
title.en: wellposed Jev request lint

input.zh: 准备提交给 Jev 的 state、题型、instructions 和 criteria。
input.en: The state, question types, instructions and criteria in a proposed Jev request.

decision.zh: 离线规则先查结构问题；对规则难判断的语义缺陷，工具再让 Jev 用 Noul 判断，例如选项是否遗漏合理的“其他”情形。
decision.en: Offline rules catch structural defects; for semantic issues they cannot settle, the tool asks Jev Noul questions, such as whether a realistic input fits none of the offered choices.

action.zh: 程序在实际业务调用前给出警告与修改建议，由开发者决定是否改写问题。
action.en: The program reports warnings and suggested fixes before a production request; the developer decides whether to revise it.

boundary.zh: 语义检查本身需要 TypeSafe API Key，可能发送待检查的请求内容；作者的标注样本和准确率未经本站独立复算，提示不能替代实测。
boundary.en: Semantic linting itself needs a TypeSafe API key and may send request content. The author's labeled samples and accuracy figures were not independently reproduced; warnings do not replace testing.

title.zh: jevmod 社区消息审核
title.en: jevmod community moderation

input.zh: 待审核消息的文本、频道话题及社区自定义规则。
input.en: A message's text, channel topic and community-defined rules.

decision.zh: Jev 对诈骗、垃圾信息、骚扰等类别分别回答 Noul，输出各类别概率。
decision.en: Jev answers separate Noul questions for categories such as scams, spam and harassment, returning a probability for each.

action.zh: 策略按概率标记并交给管理员复核；默认不删除消息，只有显式启用才执行自动处置。
action.en: Policy thresholds flag messages for moderator review; deletion is off by default and requires explicit enablement.

boundary.zh: 消息文本和频道话题会发往 TypeSafe；Jev 不可用时程序放行并记录错误。作者的审核准确率和成本数字未由本站复算，不能替代人工申诉与复核。
boundary.en: Message text and channel topic go to TypeSafe; on Jev failure the program leaves messages alone and logs the error. The author's accuracy and cost figures were not independently reproduced, and human review remains necessary.

title.zh: jev-mobile 安卓操作循环
title.en: jev-mobile Android control loop

input.zh: 用户目标、安卓界面的语义状态及当前可执行的动作集合。
input.en: A user goal, semantic Android UI state and the set of currently valid actions.

decision.zh: Jev 用 Choice 从程序给定的候选动作中选下一步，不生成任意坐标或代码。
decision.en: Jev uses Choice to select the next step from actions supplied by code; it does not generate arbitrary coordinates or code.

action.zh: 工作进程先记录变更，再操作设备并重新观察，按独立检查判断任务是否完成或需升级处理。
action.en: The worker journals the mutation, acts on the device, observes again and uses separate checks to decide whether the task is complete or needs escalation.

boundary.zh: 需要已授权的 USB 调试设备和 TypeSafe API；界面状态可能发往外部服务。本站未在真实手机上复现，风险动作和完成状态依赖项目自身的审批与验证。
boundary.en: The flow needs an authorized USB-debugging device and TypeSafe API; UI context may leave the device. This site did not reproduce it on a phone, and risky actions and completion depend on the project's own approval and verification logic.

title.zh: TypeSafe 电脑操作助手
title.en: TypeSafe computer-use assistant

input.zh: 用户目标、屏幕 OCR 或可访问性状态及程序允许的动作。
input.en: A user goal, screen OCR or accessibility state and actions allowed by the program.

decision.zh: Jev 以 Choice 选择操作种类、目标控件或站点，并可用 Noul 检查填入的文字是否合适。
decision.en: Jev uses Choice to select an action kind, target control or site, and can use Noul to check whether typed text suits a field.

action.zh: 执行器确定性地操作鼠标键盘，随后重新获取屏幕状态以判断下一步。
action.en: The executor drives the mouse and keyboard deterministically, then captures the next screen state before continuing.

boundary.zh: 项目仍属 Beta，会操作真实桌面；屏幕内容送往 TypeSafe，可选文字生成另用其他模型。本站未独立验证速度、费用或 OSWorld 成绩，实际使用应先 dry-run。
boundary.en: This beta controls a real desktop. Screen content goes to TypeSafe, and optional text generation uses another model. This site did not verify speed, cost or OSWorld results; users should start with a dry run.

input.zh: 一条软件工单、规格或缺陷报告，加上 Codex/OpenCode 工人产出的 diff、测试等“工厂证据”。
input.en: A ticket, spec, or bug report plus factory evidence such as diffs and tests produced by Codex or OpenCode workers.

decision.zh: 一次 Jev 调用并行输出实现是否完成、需求是否满足、测试是否充分、是否需要核验、工人是否卡住、是否需要人工等一组概率。
decision.en: One Jev call returns parallel probabilities for implementation completeness, requirement satisfaction, test sufficiency, verification need, worker health, and human escalation.

action.zh: 代码按阈值决定继续、纠偏、停止、重试、核验或结束；Jev 只做语义监督，不参与写码。
action.en: Code decides to continue, steer, stop, retry, verify, or finish based on thresholds; Jev only supervises and never writes code.

boundary.zh: 仓库明示效果取决于检查配置、证据、阈值与底层模型质量；本站仅读源码与文档，未独立复现其监督效果。
boundary.en: The repository states effectiveness depends on configured checks, evidence, thresholds, and models; this site read the code and docs without independently reproducing results.

input.zh: 规划目标与原版 Minecraft 服务器的实时状态；只读 Java 传感器可上报末影龙头的精确位置。
input.en: A planning goal plus live state from a vanilla Minecraft server; a read-only Java sensor can report the exact dragon-head position.

decision.zh: GPT-6 Astra 负责规划，Jev 在每步从可选玩家动作中做选择；作者最好成绩一次通关共 131 次 Jev 决策、35 次 Astra 调用。
decision.en: GPT-6 Astra plans while Jev selects each player action; the author's best verified run used 131 Jev decisions and 35 Astra calls.

action.zh: 选中的动作通过正常玩家协议发给服务器；不修改游戏规则或实体状态。
action.en: Selected actions are sent through the normal player protocol; game rules and entity state stay untouched.

boundary.zh: 8 分 43 秒为作者录制的最好成绩，龙的飞行与降落时长逐局波动；录像与证据仅存本地不入库，本站未复跑。
boundary.en: The 8m43s run is the author's best recording and dragon timings vary per run; recordings stay local and were not replayed by this site.

input.zh: NES 模拟器遥测与 RAM 解析成的紧凑 JSON（马里奥运动、跳跃轨迹、敌人、地形、历史控制结果），模型不看截图。
input.en: Emulator telemetry and RAM parsed into compact JSON covering Mario's motion, jump arc, enemies, terrain, and past control results; no screenshots.

decision.zh: Choice 从 noop、right、right_jump 等 7 个合法手柄动作中选一个，并返回完整概率分布。
decision.en: A Choice picks one of seven legal controller actions (noop, right, right_jump, …) and returns the full probability distribution.

action.zh: 模拟器推进若干帧后再次询问；每次决策的延迟、概率与置信度写入本地 JSONL 供复盘。
action.en: The emulator advances several frames and the loop repeats; latency, probabilities, and confidence are logged to local JSONL.

boundary.zh: 仓库不含 ROM，须自备合法游戏文件；默认每 8 帧决策一次的实验设置，作者未发布通关基准，本站未实测。
boundary.en: No ROM ships with the repo and a legal copy is required; the 8-frames-per-decision default is experimental, with no published completion benchmark.

input.zh: Mobilerun 真机的屏幕状态与自然语言目标。
input.en: Screen state from a Mobilerun Android phone plus a natural-language goal.

decision.zh: Jev 从可用操作中为每一步做选择；演示里 Uber 路线任务 9 步约 21 秒，从打开 App 到支付选择页。
decision.en: Jev selects each step from available actions; the Uber demo completes nine actions in about 21 seconds, from opening the app to payment selection.

action.zh: 通过 Mobilerun API 操作真机并记录执行 traces 与请求级延迟；示例任务停在支付选择页。
action.en: Actions run on a real phone through the Mobilerun API with execution traces and per-request latency; the sample task stops at payment selection.

boundary.zh: 计时为作者录制的演示；设备与 Mobilerun 服务费用另计，未演示完整下单，本站未复测。
boundary.en: Timing comes from the author's recorded demo; device and Mobilerun charges are extra, no booking is completed, and this site did not rerun it.

input.zh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 流式输出的部分转写，加上受控 Chromium 页面最多 100 个元素的索引快照。
input.en: Partial speech transcripts streamed from the Web Speech API plus an indexed snapshot of up to 100 elements on the controlled page.

decision.zh: 每次部分转写触发一次 Jev 请求，9-11 个问题覆盖意图、目标元素、站点、指令是否说完、是否对它说、是否破坏性，约 250-350ms 返回。
decision.en: Each partial transcript fires one Jev request with 9-11 questions on intent, target element, site, completeness, addressee, and destructiveness, returning in ~250-350 ms.

action.zh: 代码按阈值决定执行、等待、询问或忽略；搜索词与 URL 由代码提取成候选、Jev 只逐字挑选，不生成文本。
action.en: Code decides to act, wait, ask, or ignore; queries and URLs are extracted as candidate spans that Jev only picks verbatim — it never writes text.

boundary.zh: 麦克风依赖 Chrome/Edge 的 Web Speech API；延迟与每次约 0.0002 美元为作者环境测量，本站未实测。
boundary.en: The microphone relies on Chrome/Edge Web Speech; latency and the ~$0.0002-per-call figure are the author's measurements.

input.zh: 机载相机画面的深度与分割结果，由经典 CV 压成五个前向扇区、遮挡高度等紧凑场景；Jev 不做感知。
input.en: Depth and segmentation from the onboard camera, compressed by classical CV into five forward sectors and obstruction heights; Jev does no perception.

decision.zh: 2.5Hz 一次调用三问：Choice 选机动（保持/绕左/绕右/爬升/刹车/重捕获）、Score 评风险、Noul 判目标是否真丢失；场景指纹缓存，65 秒飞行约 110 次调用。
decision.en: At 2.5 Hz one call asks three questions — a Choice of maneuver, a Score of risk, and a Noul on whether the target is truly lost; scene fingerprinting caches repeats (~110 calls per 65 s flight).

action.zh: 战术判断仅作咨询；50Hz 安全反射层与 500Hz 几何控制器保留否决权，如爬升必须在实测障碍顶边可达时才执行。
action.en: Tactical judgment is advisory; a 50 Hz safety reflex and a 500 Hz geometric controller hold veto power, for example climb is refused unless the measured obstruction top is reachable.

boundary.zh: MuJoCo 仿真中的五站障碍课程；数字为作者单次飞行测量，非实物飞行，本站未复跑。
boundary.en: A five-station course in MuJoCo simulation; figures come from the author's flight runs, not a physical drone, and were not replayed here.

input.zh: Codex 会话的有界决策状态；完整上下文回放只给执行模型，Jev 看不到。
input.en: A bounded decision state from the Codex session; the full canonical replay goes only to the executing model, never to Jev.

decision.zh: Jev 为每次模型调用（含工具后续轮）同时选择模型与推理强度，目标是用够用的能力、不浪费配额。
decision.en: For every model call, including continuations after tools, Jev picks the model and thinking effort together, targeting sufficient capability without wasting quota.

action.zh: 经内嵌的 Codex Router 分发到 luna/terra/sol/astra；任何 Jev 错误 fail-open，原样放行。
action.en: Requests route through the embedded Codex Router fork to luna/terra/sol/astra; any Jev error fails open and traffic passes through unchanged.

boundary.zh: README 的“约省 60%”是旧策略 237 轮的历史回测，作者明示既非实测节省、也不能代表现策略。
boundary.en: The README's ~60% saving is a backtest of 237 turns under an old policy, explicitly not measured quota saved nor evidence for the current policy.

input.zh: Claude Code 刚执行完的 Bash stdout（1 万估算 token 以下直通）与任务、会话历史。
input.en: Bash stdout right after Claude Code runs it (outputs under 10,000 estimated tokens pass through) plus the task and session history.

decision.zh: 输出切块后每块一个 Noul：块内是否有任何行仍需可用；单行需要即保护整块，含此前指令依赖的值。
decision.en: Output is chunked and each chunk gets one noul — does any line still need to be available? A single needed line protects the chunk, including values earlier instructions depend on.

action.zh: 不需要的块被裁掉，其余原样进入后续轮次；错误输出、JSON/XML/diff、git diff 等整文档命令与已识别文档豁免。
action.en: Unneeded chunks are dropped and the rest flows on untouched; errors, JSON/XML/diff output, whole-document commands like git diff, and recognized documents are exempt.

boundary.zh: 与作者另一项目 fast-jev-compaction 相互独立；token 用估算而非精确分词器，压缩率未经本站实测。
boundary.en: Independent of the author's fast-jev-compaction; token counts are estimates, not exact tokenizer output, and compression was not measured here.

input.zh: Neo4j 当前节点的出边关系列表（类型、属性、目标节点标签/属性）；schema 经自省发现，不写死。
input.en: The outgoing relationships of the current Neo4j node (type, properties, target label/properties), with schema discovered live by introspection.

decision.zh: Choice 从出边中选下一条关系，Noul“目标是否已达成”同请求搭车，每跳恰好一次往返。
decision.en: A Choice picks the next relationship while a noul asks whether the goal is reached, riding in the same call so each hop costs one round trip.

action.zh: 对返回概率做 top-k 束搜索，按对数概率求和排序得到最优路径，交互式渲染邻域与路径。
action.en: Probabilities feed a top-k beam search ranked by summed log-probability, and the path is rendered interactively with its neighborhood.

boundary.zh: 笔记本与 Streamlit 应用在公开 companies2 图上实测；无 key 时失败原样展示、用明确标注的替身答案跑管线，不冒充 TypeSafe 输出。
boundary.en: Notebooks and the Streamlit app run against the public companies2 graph; without a key, failures show verbatim and clearly labelled stand-in answers drive the pipeline — never presented as TypeSafe output.

input.zh: Pi 编码 agent 待执行的 bash/write/edit 调用，以及命令执行后的输出。
input.en: Pending bash/write/edit calls from the Pi coding agent, plus what a command printed after it ran.

decision.zh: 闸门把 3 个 Noul（破坏性/数据外传/超出用户所求）与 1 个 4 级 Score（影响）放进一次请求；输出裁判再两问查泄密与失败类别。
decision.en: The gate bundles three nouls (destructive, exfiltration, beyond scope) and a four-level impact score into one request; an output judge adds two questions on secrets and failure class.

action.zh: 默认 shadow 模式只提示不拦截，可切换为执行前确认；所有错误路径 fail-open，缺 key、超时、429 都放行工具调用。
action.en: Shadow mode only notifies by default and can switch to pre-run confirmation; every error path fails open — a missing key, timeout, or 429 lets the tool call proceed.

boundary.zh: 阈值（0.90/0.70/0.85/2.50）为作者默认配置；判定层不替代宿主权限或真实安全边界。
boundary.en: Thresholds (0.90/0.70/0.85/2.50) are the author's defaults; this layer does not replace host permissions or real security boundaries.

input.zh: 任意视频的逐句转写文本，加上所选预设（辩论访谈/财报电话会/播客闲谈/发布宣传）。
input.en: Sentence-level transcript of any video plus a chosen preset (debates, earnings calls, podcasts, or pitches).

decision.zh: 按预设维度给每句打分并标记回避问题、情绪诉求、自相矛盾、炒作等信号；作者报告预设留出集准确率 99%。
decision.en: Each sentence is scored against the preset, flagging dodged questions, emotional appeals, self-contradictions, and hype; the author reports 99% held-out preset accuracy.

action.zh: 渲染成可直接发布的 16:9 成片；整场辩论完整评分成本约 0.05 美元。
action.en: Results render into a postable 16:9 edit; a full debate costs about $0.05 to score.

boundary.zh: 准确率与成本为作者自报的评测，未经本站复现；预设主要面向英文音视频内容。
boundary.en: Accuracy and cost are the author's self-reported evals, not reproduced here; presets target mostly English audio and video.

input.zh: 当前敲到一半的命令与最近 100 条去重历史。
input.en: The half-typed command line and the last 100 distinct history entries.

decision.zh: Choice 判断最可能在补全哪条历史命令并返回概率；有前缀命中走字面补全，无命中进入替换模式。
decision.en: A Choice ranks which history entry the input is most likely completing; a literal prefix match completes directly, otherwise a replace mode suggests the best fuzzy match.

action.zh: fish 式灰色建议显示在光标后并附分数，→ 或 ^E 接受；条数、阈值与最小字符数可配。
action.en: A fish-style grey suggestion with its score appears after the cursor; press → or ^E to accept, with limits and thresholds configurable.

boundary.zh: 击键即可能触发 API 调用（有 2 字符起测与阈值门控），费用由用户自理；演示 GIF 用虚构历史生成。
boundary.en: Keystrokes can trigger API calls (gated by a 2-character minimum and thresholds) at the user's expense; the demo GIF uses fabricated history.

input.zh: 用户消息、会话状态与早前工具结果；仅 TYPESAFE_API_KEY 为必需。
input.en: The user's message, conversation state, and earlier tool results; only a TYPESAFE_API_KEY is required.

decision.zh: Choice 决定要调的 MCP 工具、每个参数取自哪里、是否先确认、给哪种回复；Noul 判断字段（如截止时间）是否已给出。
decision.en: Choices pick which MCP tool to call, where each argument comes from, whether to confirm first, and the reply type; a noul checks whether fields like a due date are stated.

action.zh: 代码调用工具并只用工具返回的数据拼回复——没有任何模型写文本，页面上的值要么来自用户要么来自工具。
action.en: Code calls the tools and builds replies from their own data — no model writes text, so every value on screen is either typed by the user or returned by a tool.

boundary.zh: 附检查器可查看每条回复的完整请求、概率与代码行为；示例工具集较小，不构成通用对话替代。
boundary.en: An inspector shows the full request, probabilities, and code actions for any reply; the bundled tool set is small and not a general chat replacement.

input.zh: 扩展用代码规则预筛的“广告形”候选 DOM 元素，压成标签、类名、链接域、IAB 尺寸等紧凑 JSON。
input.en: Ad-shaped DOM candidates pre-filtered by code rules, compressed into compact JSON with tag, classes, link hosts, and standard IAB sizes.

decision.zh: 每批一次请求、每候选一个 Noul“是否付费广告”，一次拿回逐元素概率。
decision.en: One request per batch carries a noul per candidate — is this a paid advertisement? — returning one probability per element.

action.zh: P(广告)≥0.70 的元素被描红、收缩并移除；MutationObserver 捕捉懒加载，每批至多 30 个候选。
action.en: Elements with P(ad) ≥ 0.70 are outlined, shrunk, and removed; a MutationObserver catches lazy-loaded ads, capped at 30 candidates per batch.

boundary.zh: 作者明示这是趣味项目而非真广告拦截：每页消耗 token、会漏判也会误删，不处理追踪与视频广告。
boundary.en: The author calls it a fun project, not a real ad blocker: it costs tokens per page, misses ads, eats non-ads, and does nothing about tracking or video ads.

input.zh: Gmail 收件箱消息，经只读 gmail.readonly 单一 scope，仅用 list/get 类方法。
input.en: Gmail messages fetched with a single read-only gmail.readonly scope and only list/get-style methods.

decision.zh: 每封 3 问：五个托盘（需回复/更新/促销/销售/垃圾）选一、1-5 紧急度、是否真人写给你。
decision.en: Three questions per message: which of five trays (needs reply, updates, promos, sales, spam), a 1-5 urgency score, and whether a human wrote it to you.

action.zh: 按托盘与紧急度排序展示，托盘显示前两概率、用户纠错与原始答案一并存本地 SQLite；1000 封约 1 分钟、约 3 美分。
action.en: Mail sorts into trays showing top-two probabilities, with corrections stored beside original answers in local SQLite; 1,000 emails take about a minute and around 3 cents.

boundary.zh: 只读不代发不代归档；速度与成本为作者环境测量（经 Vercel AI Gateway 调 Jev），本站未复测。
boundary.en: Read-only — it never sends, archives, or labels; speed and cost are the author's measurements through the Vercel AI Gateway.

input.zh: 房屋与传感器状态，以及用户在 UI 或 YAML 里定义的 Noul/Choice/Score 问题。
input.en: House and sensor state, plus Noul/Choice/Score questions defined by the user in the UI or YAML.

decision.zh: 每个问题变成一个实体：概率、选项及其分布、或量表数值；自动化里 jev.noul/jev.choice/jev.score/jev.ask 四个动作直接作答。
decision.en: Every question becomes an entity — a probability, an option with its distribution, or a scale value — while four actions (jev.noul, jev.choice, jev.score, jev.ask) answer inside automations.

action.zh: 实体可参与自动化与 Assist 语音路由；集成统计每日调用、输入 token 与估算花费，对照每日预算。
action.en: Entities feed automations and Assist voice routing; the integration reports daily calls, input tokens, and estimated cost against a daily budget.

boundary.zh: HACS 社区自定义集成，作者声明与 TypeSafe 无关；判断质量取决于问题设计，自动化后果由用户配置负责。
boundary.en: A HACS custom integration whose author states it is not affiliated with TypeSafe; judgment quality depends on question design and automation outcomes rest on user config.

input.zh: 一个文本框的实时输入，如“周五晚 8 点和 Priya 视频”或“2400 三人平摊”。
input.en: Live typing in a single text box, such as "dinner with priya friday 8pm on zoom" or "split 2400 between 3".

decision.zh: 一次 Jev 调用并行 14 问：判断应变形为哪张卡片（日程/清单/计时器/分账/取色/投票…）及“是否视频通话”“是否紧急”等信号。
decision.en: One Jev call answers 14 parallel questions: which card the input should morph into (event, checklist, timer, bill splitter, color picker, poll, …) plus signals like "is it a video call?" or "is it urgent?".

action.zh: 日期、金额、单位与运算全部由确定性代码解析计算；无 key 或 API 异常时静默回退内置关键词分类器，完全离线可用。
action.en: Dates, amounts, units, and math are resolved by deterministic code; without a key or on API errors it silently falls back to a built-in keyword classifier and stays fully offline.

boundary.zh: 在线模式 key 只在服务端读取；离线兜底意味着默认体验不等于 Jev 精度，本站未做两种模式对比。
boundary.en: The online key is read only server-side; the offline fallback means the default experience does not reflect Jev accuracy, and no A/B comparison was made here.

input.zh: Agent trace（OpenAI 格式 messages 与工具 schema；Anthropic 内容块与 LangChain 对象亦可直接传入）。
input.en: An agent trace (OpenAI-format messages and tool schemas; Anthropic content blocks and LangChain messages also pass directly).

decision.zh: 一次请求并行输出工具选择、是否用了工具结果、有据、未越界、回答相关、完整、间接注入、PHI 等 8 项判定与分数。
decision.en: One request returns eight parallel judgments — tool choice, used tool result, groundedness, scope, relevancy, completeness, indirect injection, and PHI.

action.zh: 每条 trace 一请求、约数千分之一美分、数百毫秒，可跑在全部流量与 agent 循环内；后端可选 TypeSafe/Vercel、本地 Kev/Laya 或普通 LLM。
action.en: One request per trace at a few thousandths of a cent in a few hundred milliseconds, cheap enough for every trace and the agent loop; backends include TypeSafe/Vercel, local Kev or Laya, or a plain LLM.

boundary.zh: 示例数字取自作者 quickstart trace 的真实返回；各 metric 的有效性未经本站独立评测。
boundary.en: Example figures come from the author's quickstart trace; the validity of each metric was not independently evaluated here.

input.zh: Claude Code 中大体积 Read/Bash/Grep 结果，切成约 25 行的块。
input.en: Large Read, Bash, or Grep results in Claude Code, split into roughly 25-line blocks.

decision.zh: 每块一个 Noul“当前任务是否需要此块”；高置信不需要才隐藏，不确定的块与疑似错误的输出一律原样保留。
decision.en: Each block gets one noul — is it needed for the current task? Only confident-no blocks are hidden; uncertain blocks and outputs that look like errors always stay.

action.zh: 隐藏块替换为三行存根：隐藏了什么、廉价模型一句话摘要、以及可取回全文的召回键。
action.en: Hidden blocks become a three-line stub: what was hidden, a one-line summary from a cheap model, and a key that restores the full text on demand.

boundary.zh: 依赖判定模型的校准度，作者同时提供用 Claude Haiku 的未校准适配器备选；阈值可调，token 节省未经本站实测。
boundary.en: It leans on the judge's calibration, with an uncalibrated Claude Haiku adapter offered as a fallback; thresholds are configurable and savings were not measured here.

input.zh: 读屏采集的当前对话：安卓端走无障碍读节点，Windows 端走窗口截图 + 本地 OCR；仅本机可见会话。
input.en: The on-screen conversation captured on the user's own device — accessibility-tree reading on Android, window screenshots plus local OCR on Windows; only conversations the user can already see.

decision.zh: Jev 判断对方意图、情绪/紧张度并给候选排序；生成模型起草 3 条候选回复，胜出概率随候选一起展示。
decision.en: Jev judges the other side's intent and emotional tension and ranks candidates; a generative model drafts three replies, each shown with the win probability Jev assigned.

action.zh: 半透明悬浮窗给出判断摘要与候选，一键复制/填入输入框；发送永远由用户手动点，不碰转账红包。
action.en: A translucent overlay shows the judgment and candidates with one-click copy/fill into the input box; sending always stays manual and transfers or red packets are never touched.

boundary.zh: 判断可走 OpenRouter 或 TypeSafe 直连（用户自带 key）；读屏合规与使用场景由用户自行负责，README 未提供评测数据，本站未实测。
boundary.en: Judgments run through OpenRouter or direct TypeSafe access with user-supplied keys; users are responsible for lawful screen reading, no eval data ships in the README, and this site did not test it.

name: Glean expert routing pilot

title.zh: Glean 专家模型路由离线评估
title.en: Glean offline expert routing pilot

author: Tony Gentilcore 等 Glean 作者

input.zh: 751 条历史请求及其专家路由黄金标签；试验把生产路由简化为 3 个专家候选。
input.en: 751 historical requests with golden expert-route labels, using a three-expert simplification of the production router.

decision.zh: Jev 从 3 个预设专家中选处理请求的模型，替代原有生成式路由提示词的封闭选择步骤。
decision.en: Jev chooses one of three predefined experts for each request, replacing the bounded selection step of the generative routing prompt.

action.zh: 研究团队将选择与黄金标签及既有 LLM 路由比较，并对真实转接的 40 条样本另测调用延迟；文章未称已上线。
action.en: The team compares choices with golden labels and its LLM router, then separately measures latency on 40 actual-transfer examples; the article does not claim deployment.

boundary.zh: 仅作者公开的离线评估，没有开源实现或本站复测；8.1 倍中位提速为作者在 40 条转接样本上的自报，数据驻留及运行保障仍待解决。
boundary.en: This is an author-reported offline evaluation without public code or independent reproduction. The 8.1× median speedup comes from 40 transfer examples; data residency and operational guarantees remain open.

title.zh: jevwright 浏览器业务流程测试
title.en: jevwright browser business-flow tests

input.zh: 测试作者用自然语言写的业务步骤、当前 Chromium 页面的控件，以及声明的 API 请求和断言。
input.en: Natural-language business steps, controls on the current Chromium page, and declared API requests and assertions.

decision.zh: Jev 从当前页面定位符合步骤的控件，并对屏幕可见状态做封闭核对；模型不决定测试是否通过。
decision.en: Jev grounds each step to a control on the live page and makes bounded checks of visible state; it does not decide whether the test passed.

action.zh: Playwright 执行动作并记录语义路径；后续可无模型回放，测试成败由请求、API/数据库断言和代码监控决定。
action.en: Playwright acts and records a semantic path for later model-free replay; requests, API/database assertions and code monitors determine pass or fail.

boundary.zh: 首次探索或路径失效时需 OpenRouter/Vercel 网关密钥，纯回放不需；仓库提供源码和 CI，费用与效果数字仅为作者自报，本站未运行真实站点测试。
boundary.en: Initial grounding or healing needs an OpenRouter/Vercel gateway key; replay does not. Code and CI are public, but costs and outcomes are author-reported; this site did not run a live-site test.

title.zh: IRS 表单页分类与置信度门控
title.en: IRS form-page classification with confidence gate

input.zh: 从 PDF 文本层提取的单页文字，以及仓库生成的 IRS 表单与页面类型候选；空白页由代码直接处理。
input.en: Text extracted from one PDF page plus repository-generated IRS form and page-kind options; code handles blank pages directly.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 选择表单及 7 种页面类别；少数表单族再做一次子表单选择，返回概率。
decision.en: Jev Choice selects a form and one of seven page kinds, with a second choice for a few form families, returning probabilities.

action.zh: 程序输出表单 ID、页面类别和置信度；默认仅在表单置信度达到 0.95 时放行后续自动路由，低分交给调用方处理。
action.en: Code emits a form ID, page kind and confidence; it gates downstream routing at 0.95 by default and leaves low-confidence handling to the caller.

boundary.zh: 仅英文联邦税表；扫描件需先 OCR，州税表只辨类别不识别具体表。页面文字送往 TypeSafe；准确率、速度和费用来自作者评测，本站未复测或用于报税。
boundary.en: Limited to English federal forms. Scans need OCR, while state forms are only detected by kind. Page text goes to TypeSafe; accuracy, speed and cost are author-reported and were not remeasured or used for tax filing here.

title.zh: NetHack 合法动作选择
title.en: NetHack legal-action selection

input.zh: NetHack 终端画面、当前角色状态及程序在这一回合列出的合法动作。
input.en: The current NetHack terminal view, player state, and legal actions enumerated by code for this turn.

decision.zh: Jev 以 Choice 只从合法动作列表中选下一步，不生成任意按键指令。
decision.en: Jev uses Choice to pick the next step only from the legal-action list, without generating arbitrary keystrokes.

action.zh: 项目的 motor 将所选动作映射成按键，执行后重新读取画面并进入下一回合。
action.en: The project motor maps the selected action to keystrokes, then reads the resulting screen for the next turn.

boundary.zh: 默认运行需要本地编译的 NetHack 与付费 TypeSafe API key；源码也支持兼容协议的本地服务。仓库展示运行和决策日志，但本站未验证通关、游戏成功率或成本。
boundary.en: The default run needs a local NetHack build and a paid TypeSafe API key; source also supports a compatible local server. The repository shows runs and decision logs, but this site did not verify ascension, win rate, or cost.

title.zh: jevvium 手机验收测试生成
title.en: jevvium mobile acceptance-test generation

input.zh: YAML 验收目标、Appium 读取的当前屏幕和可操作控件，以及可选的明确断言。
input.en: A YAML acceptance goal, the current Appium screen and actionable controls, and optional explicit assertions.

decision.zh: Jev 在一次请求中用 Choice 选下一动作、用 Noul 判断目标是否已达成，并从给定输入中选择字段值。
decision.en: In one request, Jev uses Choice to select the next action, Noul to judge goal completion, and closed choices for field values.

action.zh: Appium 执行动作；达到目标且断言成立后，工具生成固定选择器的 WebdriverIO 测试，并用不调用模型的 Appium 回放核验。
action.en: Appium performs the action; once the goal and assertions hold, the tool writes a WebdriverIO test with fixed selectors and validates it through model-free Appium replay.

boundary.zh: 需要 Appium、设备或模拟器及 TypeSafe key。若验收条件没有 expect，通过判定可能只依据模型判断；作者的耗时和通过率未由本站复测。
boundary.en: Requires Appium, a device or simulator, and a TypeSafe key. Without explicit expect assertions, a pass may rest only on the model judgment; author-reported timings and pass rates were not reproduced here.

title.zh: RAG 段落筛选与可回答性门控
title.en: RAG passage screening and answerability gate

input.zh: 待入库文档段落、用户查询和向量库检出的候选片段。
input.en: Document paragraphs before indexing, a user query, and candidate passages retrieved from a vector store.

decision.zh: Jev 对段落和片段做封闭判断：是否杂质、是否面向 AI 的指令、是否相关或与问题前提冲突，以及现有证据能否回答。
decision.en: Jev makes bounded judgments on whether paragraphs or passages are boilerplate, instructions aimed at AI, relevant, contradictory, or sufficient to answer.

action.zh: 代码按阈值丢弃或隔离段落、排序并保留证据；可回答时才构建给生成模型的提示，否则拒答。
action.en: Code applies thresholds to drop or quarantine paragraphs, rank and retain evidence, and build an answer prompt only when the gate passes; otherwise it abstains.

boundary.zh: 需另配向量库与嵌入模型；无 Jev key 时可降级为普通向量排序。README 的命中率、抗注入和成本为作者自报，本站未复测。
boundary.en: Requires a vector store and embedder; without a Jev key it can degrade to plain vector ranking. Recall, injection screening, and cost figures in the README are author-reported and were not remeasured here.

title.zh: Rox 销售资料检索离线实验
title.en: Rox offline sales-retrieval evaluation

input.zh: 75 条近似生产的销售查询及从通话转录、邮件、CRM、新闻和文档检出的候选片段。
input.en: Seventy-five production-like sales queries and candidate passages from transcripts, email, CRM, news, and documents.

decision.zh: Jev Score 用“不相关、稍相关、大致相关、直接相关”四级规则评判各候选片段。
decision.en: Jev Score rates each candidate passage on four levels from not relevant to directly relevant.

action.zh: 团队按评分重排候选，并与 GPT-5 Mini 的重排及另一模型建立的基准标签作离线比较。
action.en: The team reranks candidates by score and compares the offline results with GPT-5 Mini reranking and labels from another model.

boundary.zh: 仅作者原帖和实验图片，未取得代码或样本；75 条查询规模有限。速度、成本及准确率均为作者自报，本站未复测，不能称已在生产检索中部署。
boundary.en: Only author posts and experiment images are available, with no public code or sample set. The 75-query evaluation is small; speed, cost, and accuracy are author-reported, not independently reproduced or proof of deployment.

title.zh: 风险画像监控与分层调查
title.en: Profile-based risk monitoring and escalation

input.zh: 用户定义的风险主题、地点和触发条件，以及 You.com 返回的当前摘要与来源。
input.en: A user-defined risk topic, locations, and policy triggers plus current You.com highlights and sources.

decision.zh: Jev Noul 判有无实质威胁并筛选查询提案，Score 评结果相关性，Choice 从低、中、严重三级选最终级别。
decision.en: Jev Noul judges threat and query proposals, Score rates retrieved evidence, and Choice selects low, medium, or critical severity.

action.zh: 代码按阈值记录清洁巡检或启动限额深查；Qwen 仅提议查询和合成报告，程序保存带来源的报告及判断概率。
action.en: Code records a clean sweep or starts a budgeted deep dive; Qwen proposes queries and drafts prose while the program persists a source-linked report and judgment probabilities.

boundary.zh: 作者公开了三次实时巡检，但成本、结果质量及风险报告内容未由本站复核；外部检索和模型服务会接收相应上下文。
boundary.en: The author reports three live sweeps, but costs, report quality, and factual conclusions were not independently checked. External search and model services receive the relevant context.

title.zh: 知识库写入准入离线评测
title.en: Offline knowledge-write admission evaluation

input.zh: 待写入记录、5 至 9 条已有记录，以及修改记录的旧版本；仓库用 85 条合成样本评估。
input.en: An incoming record, five to nine accepted records, and the old version of an edited record, evaluated on 85 synthetic cases.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 对每条记录判断冲突、重述或兼容，并对修改判更正、改写、补充或变义。
decision.en: Jev Choice classifies each comparison as contradictory, restated, or compatible and each edit as correction, rewording, addition, or meaning change.

action.zh: 评测代码汇总概率，只有低风险判断足够确定才模拟自动接纳，否则转人工；与其他决策模型对照。
action.en: Evaluation code aggregates probabilities and simulates automatic admission only when risk is confidently low; otherwise it sends the write for human review and compares other decision models.

boundary.zh: 85 条均为虚构组织的合成案例；作者的正确率、顺序稳定性和延迟不是本站复测，更不能当作真实生产准入质量。
boundary.en: All 85 cases use fictional organizations. The author-reported accuracy, order stability, and latency were not remeasured here and do not establish production write-admission quality.

title.zh: Wisp 语音桌面动作路由
title.en: Wisp voice-to-desktop action routing

input.zh: 按键录下的语音转写、近期会话及当前窗口等受限上下文。
input.en: Push-to-talk transcript, recent conversation, and bounded context such as the active window.

decision.zh: Jev 经 OpenRouter Decisions 以 Choice 选启动应用、工具、代理、回答或澄清，并判断具体目标。
decision.en: Jev through OpenRouter Decisions uses Choice to select app launch, tool, agent, answer, or clarification and to identify a target.

action.zh: 守护进程按风险级别调用桌面工具或启动编码代理；普通问答由单独的聊天模型生成文字，危险 shell 动作需确认。
action.en: The daemon invokes desktop tools or starts a coding agent according to risk tier; a separate chat model writes ordinary answers, and shell actions require confirmation.

boundary.zh: 主要面向 Linux Omarchy/Hyprland，macOS 为作者提供的移植；运行需麦克风、转写模型和 OpenRouter key，语音上下文可能送外部。本站未在真实桌面复现。
boundary.en: Primarily targets Linux Omarchy/Hyprland, with an author-provided macOS port. It needs microphone access, transcription, and an OpenRouter key; voice context may leave the device. This site did not reproduce desktop actions.

title.zh: claude-referee 完成声明核对
title.en: claude-referee completion-claim check

area.zh: 编码 Agent 结果核验

input.zh: Claude Code 的测试或 lint 输出，以及用户写出的明确完成条件。
input.en: Test or lint output from Claude Code and explicit completion criteria supplied by the user.

decision.zh: 代码先解析退出码、跳过测试及摘要，再让 Jev 对每条条件用 Noul 判断现有证据是否足以支持。
decision.en: Code first parses exit codes, skipped tests, and summaries; Jev then uses a Noul for each criterion to judge whether the evidence supports it.

action.zh: CLI 输出 met、unsure 或 missing 并留本地收据，让使用者补跑或检查缺失证据。
action.en: The CLI reports met, unsure, or missing and keeps a local receipt so the user can rerun checks or inspect missing evidence.

boundary.zh: 当前自动 Stop hook 仅为 shadow 记录；阻止停止的 active 模式仍在计划中。顺序敏感与成本数据为作者自报，本站未复测，不能说项目已自动拦截不实完成声明。
boundary.en: The automatic Stop hook currently records in shadow mode; active blocking is planned. Order-sensitivity and cost measurements are author-reported and unverified here, so this is not evidence that false completion claims are already blocked automatically.

title.zh: PageIndex + Jev 长文档分层找页
title.en: PageIndex and Jev hierarchical page search

input.zh: 用户问题和 PageIndex 从 PDF 构建的章节树：节点标题、摘要、页码范围及页文本。
input.en: A user question and a PageIndex tree built from a PDF, with node titles, summaries, page ranges, and page text.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 逐层选择最可能回答问题的章节和页面；Noul 再判断候选页是否确有回答信息。
decision.en: Jev Choice picks likely sections and pages level by level, then Noul checks whether candidate pages contain answer information.

action.zh: 代码按树路径缩小候选并返回页码、文本和判断轨迹，供调用者查证；项目本身不生成最终答案。
action.en: Code narrows candidates along the tree and returns pages, text, and the judgment trace for inspection; it does not generate a final answer.

boundary.zh: 需要 TypeSafe 和 PageIndex API key；PDF 上传 PageIndex 云端。仓库演示与搜索效果未由本站复测，候选页仍需核对原文。
boundary.en: Requires TypeSafe and PageIndex API keys, and uploads the PDF to PageIndex cloud. Demonstrations and retrieval quality were not independently reproduced; returned pages still need source review.

title.zh: Claude Code 自动模式权限预判
title.en: Claude Code auto-mode permission precheck

area.zh: 编码 Agent 权限判断

input.zh: Claude Code auto mode 待审批的工具调用、近期用户消息及项目路径。
input.en: A pending Claude Code auto-mode tool call, recent user messages, and the project path.

decision.zh: Jev 一次回答八个 Noul：调用是否符合请求、各项风险及是否含自称已获批准的引导文字；代码按阈值判 allow、deny 或 defer。
decision.en: Jev answers eight Nouls in one request about user intent, risks, and approval-steering text; code thresholds yield allow, deny, or defer.

action.zh: 明显可允许的调用跳过原生分类器，明确危险且未请求的调用被阻止；不确定的仍交回 Claude Code 原生分类器。
action.en: Clearly allowed calls bypass the built-in classifier, clearly risky unrequested calls are denied, and uncertain calls return to Claude Code built-in classification.

boundary.zh: 仅适用于可用 mods 的 Claude Code auto mode。待审批命令和近期消息可能发给 TypeSafe，包括未被规则识别的内嵌秘密；模型错误回退原生分类器。作者延迟与安全样本结果未经本站复测，不能视为通用安全保证。
boundary.en: Requires Claude Code auto mode with mods. Pending commands and recent messages may go to TypeSafe, including inline secrets missed by filters. Model errors defer to the built-in classifier; author-reported latency and safety samples were not reproduced and are not a general security guarantee.

title.zh: 稀薄气体流动的受限决策与求解
title.en: Bounded rarefied-gas flow planning

input.zh: 用户用自然语言描述平板间的气体流动，代码先识别数字和物理单位。
input.en: A plain-language description of gas flow between plates, with quantities and units first extracted by code.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 在封闭选项中识别流型、几何、气体及各量值的角色；代码据置信度决定运行、追问或拒绝。
decision.en: Jev Choice selects flow type, geometry, gas, and quantity roles from closed options; code uses confidence to run, ask for clarification, or decline.

action.zh: 确定性代码计算 Knudsen 数、选择适用的流体或动力学求解器，并输出有单位的剪切应力或流量。
action.en: Deterministic code computes the Knudsen number, selects an applicable fluid or kinetic solver, and returns shear stress or flow rate with units.

boundary.zh: 只覆盖仓库支持的平板 Couette/Poiseuille 场景；作者对求解器与 Jev 成本的校验未由本站复跑。录制答案可离线重放，不能把每次示例运行都说成实时 Jev 调用。
boundary.en: Limited to the supported parallel-plate Couette and Poiseuille problems. The author solver validation and Jev costs were not reproduced; recorded answers can replay offline, so not every demo run is a live Jev call.

title.zh: Jev 批量重排 Agent 记忆候选
title.en: Batch reranking agent memories with Jev

input.zh: 用户检索问题和本地记忆库预检索出的最多 40 条候选，内容先截断并做秘密信息过滤。
input.en: A user query and up to 40 pre-retrieved local memories, truncated and passed through a secret redactor.

decision.zh: Jev 在一次 System One 请求中对每条候选回答一个 Noul：它是否有助于回答问题，并返回相关性概率。
decision.en: In one System One call, Jev answers one Noul per candidate about whether it helps answer the query and returns relevance probabilities.

action.zh: 代码按概率重排并将记忆交给后续回答步骤；请求失败或答案不完整时回退到本地交叉编码器。
action.en: Code reranks the memories for the downstream answer step; request failure or incomplete answers fall back to a local cross-encoder.

boundary.zh: Jev 重排需显式启用，会把查询和候选记忆发给 TypeSafe。作者两个语料的排名提升未由本站复测；其评测未显示最终回答优于免费重排器，最高分也不证明候选含答案。
boundary.en: Jev reranking is opt-in and sends query and memory text to TypeSafe. Author-reported ranking gains on two corpora were not reproduced; their evaluation did not show better final answers than a free reranker, and top score does not prove answerability.

title.zh: Jev 筛选社交素材研究样本
title.en: Jev shortlists social content for creator research

input.zh: 平台帖子经字幕、画面文字、标题、评论与互动数据转成带来源的文字证据包。
input.en: Posts become sourced text evidence packets from transcripts, on-screen text, captions, comments, and metrics.

decision.zh: Jev 对每个帖子按固定 rubric 回答类型化问题，判断是否值得进入后续研究候选。
decision.en: Jev answers typed fixed-rubric questions for each post to decide whether it belongs in the research shortlist.

action.zh: 代码按阈值和多样性筛选少数素材，再将幸存者交给 Claude 解释模式、草拟创意。
action.en: Code applies thresholds and diversity selection, then sends survivors to Claude to explain patterns and draft concepts.

boundary.zh: 仓库说明后端及 fixture 流程已实现，前端仍在计划中；本站只核对源码和 README，未接入真实平台或复测筛选质量，Jev 与 Claude 服务均需凭据。
boundary.en: The repository says backend and fixture flow are implemented while the frontend is planned. This site checked code and README only, not live platform integration or selection quality; Jev and Claude require credentials.

title.zh: Jev 在编码 Agent 编辑后检查团队规则
title.en: Jev checks team rules after coding-agent edits

area.zh: 编码 Agent 质量反馈

input.zh: 编码 Agent 刚修改的文件内容及仓库配置的团队规则。
input.en: Code just edited by a coding agent and repository-configured team rules.

decision.zh: TypeSafe Jev 对各条规则作 Noul 判断，返回是否出现需要提醒的违例概率。
decision.en: TypeSafe Jev answers Nouls for configured rules, returning probabilities of violations worth flagging.

action.zh: 编辑钩子及时把疑似违例反馈给 Agent 修复，并记录检查；服务异常时放行编辑。
action.en: A post-edit hook reports likely violations to the agent for repair and records checks; service failures let the edit proceed.

boundary.zh: 可改用 Cloudflare Clef，但作者称其准确率尚未测量；演示视频含示意场景。README 的延迟、成本及违例下降来自作者实验，本站未复测，也不替代确定性 lint 与人工审查。
boundary.en: Cloudflare Clef is optional, with accuracy not yet measured by the author; the demo includes an illustrative scene. README latency, cost, and violation reductions are author results, unverified here, and do not replace deterministic lint or review.

title.zh: 思源 AI 工具调用的 Jev 自动审查
title.en: Jev review of SiYuan AI tool calls

area.zh: 笔记 Agent 权限审查

input.zh: 思源 AI 待确认的工具名称、参数与影响，以及用户请求和 Agent 自述意图；过长字段截断并标记省略。
input.en: A pending SiYuan AI tool name, arguments, and effects plus the user request and agent-stated intent; long fields are truncated with omissions marked.

decision.zh: Jev 一次请求回答两个 Choice（是否获用户授权、操作影响等级）和一个 Noul（待审内容是否自称已获授权）。
decision.en: In one request, Jev answers two Choices about user authorization and action impact, plus a Noul about self-authorizing text inside the pending action.

action.zh: 代码校验回答并按置信度阈值决定 allow、deny 或 ask；非仅提示模式下操作原生审批卡片，疑问则保留给用户。
action.en: Code validates answers and applies confidence thresholds for allow, deny, or ask; outside advisory mode it acts on the native approval card and leaves uncertain calls to the user.

boundary.zh: 仅在思源已配置并启用决策模型且会话选择自动审查时生效。工具参数和用户请求可能送到模型服务；授权判断可能误判，本站未在真实会话验证自动批准行为。
boundary.en: Requires an enabled decision model in SiYuan and auto-review selected for the session. Tool arguments and user requests may be sent to the provider; authorization decisions can be wrong, and this site did not test live approvals.

title.zh: Jev 为七种棋类选择合法着法
title.en: Jev selects legal moves across seven board games

input.zh: 当前棋局、执棋方、引擎枚举的合法着法及确定性战术事实。
input.en: The current board state, side to move, legal moves enumerated by the engine, and deterministic tactical facts.

decision.zh: Jev 的 Choice 对候选着法给出概率；代码只接受与引擎合法着法匹配的选项。
decision.en: Jev Choice provides probabilities for candidate moves; code accepts only options matching the engine legal moves.

action.zh: 战术层可优先处理致胜或防败着法；否则代码取最高概率或在前几项中按概率采样，再由棋局引擎执行并记录。
action.en: A tactics layer can override for wins or defenses; otherwise code takes the top move or samples among top options, then the game engine executes and records it.

boundary.zh: 仓库另有 mock、随机和 Rapfi 渠道，并非每局都调用 Jev；线上站点与胜率为作者材料，本站只核对源码，未实战复现。
boundary.en: The repository also has mock, random, and Rapfi modes, so not every game calls Jev. Live-site operation and win rates are author claims; this site checked source but did not replay matches.

title.zh: Factorio 的 Jev 宏观目标与动作选择
title.en: Jev macro goals and actions in Factorio

input.zh: 游戏快照中的资源、物品栏、机器状态和位置；代码先枚举当前能执行的动作。
input.en: A game snapshot with nearby resources, inventory, machine state, and position; code first enumerates actions possible now.

decision.zh: Jev 在一次 System One 请求中以 Choice 选目标和下一动作，以 Noul 判断是否卡住，以 Score 评估调整紧急度。
decision.en: In one System One request, Jev uses Choices for goal and next action, a Noul for stuck state, and a Score for urgency.

action.zh: 代码核验动作仍在候选中并设置置信度门槛；达标则让后端执行，否则改用确定性策略，再读取执行后状态并留记录。
action.en: Code checks that the action remains in the candidates and meets a confidence floor; otherwise it uses a deterministic fallback, then reads and records the post-action state.

boundary.zh: 无 key 的离线 mock 是规则替身，不是 Jev 实测；原生 Factorio/FLE 需专用可重置世界。基础循环虽记录执行后状态，未定义完整后置条件验证；本站未运行游戏。
boundary.en: The offline no-key mock is rule-based, not Jev inference; native Factorio/FLE needs a dedicated resettable world. The basic loop records post-action state but has no full postcondition check; gameplay was not reproduced here.

title.zh: Spring AI 用 Jev 有界纠正模型回答
title.en: Bounded Spring AI answer refinement with Jev

input.zh: 原始请求、模型候选回答和 advisor 顺序允许看到的工具调用或检索上下文。
input.en: The original request, a candidate model answer, and tool-call or retrieval context visible at the advisor position.

decision.zh: JevJudge 对标准分别提出 Noul、Choice 或 Score，代码按各自阈值给出通过、失败或不确定；可确定的 Java predicate 检查在本地完成。
decision.en: JevJudge asks Noul, Choice, or Score questions per criterion; code thresholds yield pass, fail, or inconclusive. Deterministic Java predicate checks run locally.

action.zh: advisor 对未通过回答从原请求重建反馈并有界重试；返回通过的回答，或按配置返回最佳候选／抛错。
action.en: The advisor rebuilds feedback from the original request and retries failed answers within a budget, then returns a passing answer or, by configuration, the best candidate or an error.

boundary.zh: 非官方 Spring AI 扩展；瞬时 judge 失败默认可返回未经评审的答案，工具是否随重试再执行取决于 advisor 顺序。此纠正流程不支持流式输出，本站未调用 API 或证明答案质量提高。
boundary.en: A community Spring AI extension. Transient judge failures may return an unjudged answer by default, and advisor order determines whether retries rerun tools. Refinement is non-streaming; this site did not call the API or prove better answers.

title.zh: Jev 在 Magic 对局中选择并校验合法动作
title.en: Jev choices validated by a Magic game engine

input.zh: 当前玩家视角的掩码游戏快照、牌组和引擎提供的可支付合法动作；不给模型调试日志中的对手抽牌信息。
input.en: A masked snapshot from the current player perspective, deck context, and engine-provided affordable legal actions; opponent draws from debug logs are excluded.

decision.zh: OpenRouter Jev 以原生 Choice 分阶段选择出牌及目标等细项，也处理起手换牌与轮抽；只接受程序给定的选项 ID。
decision.en: OpenRouter Jev uses native Choices in stages for plays and details such as targets, as well as mulligans and drafts; only supplied option IDs are accepted.

action.zh: 代码组装动作并让权威引擎校验；拒绝后向 Jev 提供错误做一次纠正，仍失败或预算用尽时回退到内置 AI。
action.en: Code constructs an action and validates it against the authoritative engine. Rejection gives Jev one correction attempt; continued failure or exhausted budget falls back to built-in AI.

boundary.zh: Jev 接入目前限定本地开发模式，仍需 OpenRouter key。项目包含大量规则与可选模型渠道，不是每局都调用 Jev；本站未验证完整 Magic 规则覆盖、实战表现或延迟。
boundary.en: Jev is currently limited to local development mode and requires an OpenRouter key. The project has rules and alternative model modes, so not every game uses Jev; full Magic coverage, match performance, and latency were not verified here.

title.zh: Reflex：遥测驱动的熔断与恢复探测
title.en: Reflex: telemetry-guided circuit breaking and recovery probes

input.zh: 当前熔断状态与版本、Datadog 短/长窗口中的失败率、超时、延迟及队列信息，可选 Toto 预测。
input.en: Circuit phase and revision, short/long Datadog windows of failures, timeouts, latency and queue data, plus optional Toto forecasts.

decision.zh: Jev 通过一个 Choice 在 Open、Probe、NoChange 中提议动作；预测只能作为证据，不能替代恢复探测。
decision.en: A single Choice asks Jev to recommend Open, Probe or NoChange. Forecasts are evidence and cannot replace recovery probes.

action.zh: 执行器检查版本、遥测时效、冷却时间与状态约束后才改变熔断状态；连续 5 次成功探测由代码闭合，失败探测重新打开，推理失败保持原状态。
action.en: The executor checks revisions, telemetry freshness, cooldowns and state constraints before applying a transition. Code closes the circuit after five successful probes, reopens it on a failed probe and leaves it unchanged on inference failure.

boundary.zh: 依据作者提供的模拟器与真实 SDK 接入代码核验，本站未运行 Datadog/Toto/Jev，也未验证生产环境可靠性或收益。
boundary.en: Verified from the author’s simulator and SDK integration code. This site did not run Datadog/Toto/Jev or validate production reliability or outcomes.

title.zh: Alertmanager：保留通知的告警分流
title.en: Alertmanager: triage annotations that preserve notifications

input.zh: Alertmanager 告警组的 alertname、service、severity 和 summary/description；截断或超过 10 条的组直接进入复核。
input.en: Alertmanager group labels such as alertname, service and severity, with summary/description annotations. Truncated groups or groups over ten alerts go directly to review.

decision.zh: Jev 在 incident、routine、other 中做 Choice；代码把 other 或概率低于 0.9 的答案转为 review。
decision.en: Jev chooses incident, routine or other; code maps other or a probability below 0.9 to review.

action.zh: 中继向每个原始通知附加 jevDecision 后转发，不静默、抑制、解除或丢弃报警；Jev 失败仍以 review 转发，下游发送失败返回 503 供重试。
action.en: The relay forwards every original notification with a jevDecision annotation. It does not silence, inhibit, resolve or drop alerts; Jev failures are forwarded as review and downstream delivery failures return HTTP 503 for retries.

boundary.zh: 作者说明只用合成输入试过 Jev API，没有真实 Alertmanager 实例；本站仅核查源码与 README，未测生产告警、端到端投递或模型分类质量。
boundary.en: The author reports an API exercise with synthetic input and no live Alertmanager instance. This site reviewed source and README only, without testing production alerts, end-to-end delivery or classification quality.

title.zh: Jevons Talking：有限菜单逐键拼句
title.en: Jevons Talking: composing text through finite keyboard choices

input.zh: 用户问题、已拼文本、最近按键，以及 WordNet 预测词、字母、标点、退格和结束键组成的菜单。
input.en: A question, partial reply, recent picks and a menu of WordNet predictions, letters, punctuation, backspace and stop keys.

decision.zh: 每步 Jev 通过 Choice 选择当前菜单中的一键；程序还可用 Noul 判断是否结束或需要修正。
decision.en: Each step uses a Jev Choice to select a key from the current menu, with optional Noul checks for completion or corrections.

action.zh: 代码追加词或字符、更新前缀预测、执行退格或结束，并记录概率轨迹；步数预算限制循环。
action.en: Code appends words or characters, updates prefix predictions, applies backspace or stops, and records probability traces. A step budget bounds the loop.

boundary.zh: 实验受字典与菜单限制，仓库转录只是作者样本；本站未调用 API、验证回复质量或认证辅助沟通用途。
boundary.en: The experiment is constrained by its dictionary and menus. Repository transcripts are author samples; this site did not call the API, validate reply quality or certify assistive communication use.

title.zh: Railroad Route：一句话控制矿车开关
title.en: Railroad Route: one sentence controls mine-cart switches

input.zh: 玩家写的英文或葡文句子、已布置轨道和本关所有开关的有限问题。
input.en: An English or Portuguese player sentence, the edited track board and all finite switch questions for the level.

decision.zh: 一次 Jev 请求并行判断 Choice 出口、Noul 闸门与 Score 等级；程序按阈值或四舍五入读为具体开关结果。
decision.en: One Jev request batches Choice exits, Noul gates and Score levels; code maps them to switch results using thresholds or rounding.

action.zh: 服务端验证答案后逐格模拟矿车，返回到矿、错误隧道或脱轨结果，并按路径、置信边界和用轨数评分。
action.en: The backend validates answers, simulates the cart square by square and reports arrival, a wrong tunnel or derailment, then scores the route, decision margins and track usage.

boundary.zh: 限定五关的游戏，作者实时 API 测试和延迟为自报，参考解与回放不等于本站复现，也不是通用物理规划器。
boundary.en: A five-level game. Author live API and latency results, reference solutions and replay tests were not reproduced here and do not establish general physical planning ability.

title.zh: sift：生成简报前筛选信息与来源
title.en: sift: filter items and sources before generating digests

input.zh: 配置中的用户兴趣、多来源候选条目及来源摘要。
input.en: A configured interest profile, collected items and per-source summaries.

decision.zh: 真实 Jev 后端对条目批量做 Score 价值判断，用 Noul 评估来源是否值得生成报告。
decision.en: The real Jev backend batches item relevance Scores and uses Nouls to judge whether sources merit reports.

action.zh: 按配置阈值筛选后交给 LLM 生成双语简报；调用失败或不确定时保留候选，过滤后全空的来源保留少量高分条目。
action.en: Configured thresholds filter inputs before bilingual LLM report generation. Failed or uncertain items are retained, and an emptied source keeps a small top-ranked fallback.

boundary.zh: 真实 SDK 和 mock 分开；本站仅核查源码，没有验证作者的节省量、简报发布结果或被过滤信息的召回率。
boundary.en: Real SDK and mock paths are separate. This site reviewed code only and did not validate author savings, published reports or recall of filtered information.

title.zh: JevBot：先观察再按策略审核 Discord 消息
title.en: JevBot: observe Discord detections before policy enforcement

input.zh: 当前 Discord 消息、同作者最近消息，以及频道规则和历史违规记录。
input.en: A Discord message, recent messages from the same author, channel rules and prior strikes.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 区分 spam、legitimate、uncertain；代码再核对垃圾概率、置信度和确定性规则。
decision.en: A Jev Choice labels spam, legitimate or uncertain; code then applies spam probability, confidence and deterministic-rule checks.

action.zh: 新服务器默认 Observe，只记录；不确定结果进入人工复核。配置允许后可告警、删帖或超时，执行前再读设置并记录失败，不自动封禁。
action.en: New servers start in Observe and log detections. Uncertainty goes to review. Configured enforcement can warn, delete or time out after rechecking settings, with failed actions recorded and no automatic bans.

boundary.zh: 需要自有 Discord、Cloudflare 和 TypeSafe 配置；本站未连接真实服务器、验证身份控制、误判率或线上删除结果。
boundary.en: Requires Discord, Cloudflare and TypeSafe configuration. This site did not connect to a live server or validate access controls, false positives or actual deletions.

title.zh: HiringCafe：搜索词与简历的职位相关度评分
title.en: HiringCafe: job relevance scoring for queries and resumes

input.zh: 用户搜索词或简历与一条职位描述。
input.en: A user search query or resume paired with a job description.

decision.zh: 作者称 Jev 将匹配相关度评为 1–10 分，并与其他模型及团队人工标注比较。
decision.en: The author reports Jev rating relevance on a 1–10 scale and comparing it with other models and team annotations.

action.zh: 作者称把这些判断用于 HiringCafe 职位搜索和简历匹配结果；本次原帖提供了两个相关度任务的评测。
action.en: The author says the judgments support HiringCafe job search and resume matching, with evaluations for both relevance tasks in the thread.

boundary.zh: 仅作者原帖及 TypeSafe 推荐，无可检查源码。500 条团队标注样本、用户规模、费用与效果均为作者自报，本站未取得样本或复现评测，也不猜具体 API 请求形状。
boundary.en: Author posts and a TypeSafe recommendation only, without inspectable source. The 500 team-labeled samples, user scale, costs and outcomes are author reports; this site did not obtain data, reproduce evaluation or infer the API request schema.

title.zh: Jev accounting：交易分类后生成复核 CSV
title.en: Jev accounting: transaction suggestions with a review CSV

input.zh: CSV 中的交易描述、有符号金额和币种，以及固定的示例账户类别。
input.en: Transaction descriptions, signed amounts and currencies from CSV, with fixed illustrative account categories.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 选类别；代码读取所选类别概率，低于 0.85、缺失、非法答案或 Unassigned 都进入复核。
decision.en: A Jev Choice selects a category. Code checks its probability and routes values below 0.85, missing probabilities, invalid responses or Unassigned to review.

action.zh: 保留原始交易与顺序，同时展示建议、分配和复核原因，导出 CSV；原型没有向记账系统写入。
action.en: Keeps original transactions and order, displays suggestions, assignments and review reasons, then exports CSV without writing to an accounting system.

boundary.zh: v0.1 原型、八条合成示例；作者的烟测不证明会计准确率或节省量。本站未提交真实交易、调用 Gateway 或复现记账结果。
boundary.en: A v0.1 prototype with eight synthetic examples. Author smoke tests do not establish accounting accuracy or savings; this site did not submit real transactions, call the Gateway or reproduce accounting outcomes.

title.zh: mappity：用概率点亮符合愿望的地点
title.en: mappity: probabilistic place matching on a map

input.zh: 用户自然语言愿望、代码获取的场所类型、地点事实和可选街景上下文。
input.en: A natural-language wish, fetched place types and facts, with optional street context.

decision.zh: Jev 先做有限请求分类与场所类型判断，再用 Noul 判断地点和街道是否匹配；为高分结果从已有事实中选解释。
decision.en: Jev classifies the bounded request and place types, then uses Nouls for place/street relevance and selects an explanation from existing facts.

action.zh: 代码执行地理查询与硬约束过滤，必要时组合地点/街道概率，将匹配结果在地图上高亮并展示选中的事实。
action.en: Code performs geographic lookup and hard-constraint filtering, combines place/street probabilities when needed and highlights matches with the selected facts.

boundary.zh: 依据 Jev SDK 接线与作者演示核验，本站未测真实地图召回、定位或效果；可选 Shingi 是独立模型，其校准不能外推到本应用。
boundary.en: Verified from Jev SDK integration and author demonstrations, without testing live map recall, location accuracy or outcomes. Optional Shingi is a separate model whose calibration cannot be assumed valid for this app.

title.zh: ex-regex：按含义查找和替换原文片段
title.en: ex-regex: find and replace source spans by meaning

input.zh: 原始文本、代码枚举的候选片段及自然语言匹配条件，例如哪些句子在请求退款。
input.en: Original text, enumerated candidate spans and a natural-language condition such as whether a sentence requests a refund.

decision.zh: Jev 对候选做有类型的语义判断，返回概率；库区分匹配、未匹配、不确定及调用失败。
decision.en: Jev returns typed semantic judgments and probabilities for candidates, while the library distinguishes match, non-match, uncertainty and call failures.

action.zh: Python API 返回带偏移量的原文切片，并据结果执行查找、提取、替换或分割；代码提供缓存、回放和预算限制。
action.en: The Python API returns verbatim spans with offsets for finding, extraction, replacement or splitting, with caching, replay and budget limits in code.

boundary.zh: 原文切片限制了虚构字符串，但不保证匹配正确。作者合成评测与成本为自报，本站未调用模型、复测漏检或验证可靠脱敏。
boundary.en: Verbatim slicing limits invented strings but does not guarantee correct matches. Author synthetic evaluations and costs were not reproduced; model quality, missed spans and reliable redaction were not validated here.

title.zh: Vulnder：技术栈判断辅助漏洞信息匹配
title.en: Vulnder: stack judgments assist vulnerability matching

input.zh: 用户描述的技术栈、代码解析出的组件和候选产品名。
input.en: A user-described software stack, parsed components and candidate product names.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 判断规模和托管环境，Noul 判断注入、候选产品适配和外网暴露；缺失答案保留未知。
decision.en: Jev Choices infer scale and hosting, while Nouls assess injection, product fit and internet exposure; missing answers remain unknown.

action.zh: 代码使用这些判断辅助产品解析与暴露标记，再匹配 CVE；优先级由公开利用信号和确定性启发式规则计算，输出页面、JSON 或 Atom。
action.en: Code uses judgments to assist product resolution and exposure flags, then matches CVEs. Public exploitation signals and deterministic heuristics compute priorities for page, JSON or Atom output.

boundary.zh: Jev 失败时保留基础解析；技术栈写入可分享 URL。本站未验证漏洞覆盖、产品匹配或风险校准，相关排名只是该项目启发式输出。
boundary.en: Base parsing remains available on Jev failure, and stack URLs are shareable. This site did not validate vulnerability coverage, product matches or risk calibration; rankings are this project’s heuristic output.

title.zh: Jev Skill Typeahead：发送前预览 Skill 调用概率
title.en: Jev Skill Typeahead: preview skill probabilities before sending

input.zh: 正在输入的提示词和用户已安装的有限 Skill 候选。
input.en: A prompt being typed and the finite set of installed skill candidates.

decision.zh: 作者称 Jev 预测哪些 Skill 最可能被 Claude 调用，并估计各项概率。
decision.en: The author says Jev predicts the skills Claude is most likely to invoke and estimates their probabilities.

action.zh: 界面在发送请求之前显示预测，供用户理解或调整提示；原帖还提供了公开源码链接。
action.en: The UI shows predictions before the request is sent so users can understand or adjust prompts; the post also links public source.

boundary.zh: 仅作者原帖与演示说明，本轮未精读该源码或核验预测准确率；没有推断具体 API primitive，也不把预计概率当作实际 Skill 执行保证。
boundary.en: Author post and demo description only. Source and prediction accuracy were not reviewed in this run; no API primitive was inferred and predicted probabilities do not guarantee actual skill execution.

title.zh: VibeFilter：按自然语言条件过滤表格
title.en: VibeFilter: filter table rows by a natural-language condition

input.zh: 用户输入的自然语言条件，以及其他 SQL 过滤后各行选定文本列。
input.en: A user-written condition and selected text columns from rows remaining after other SQL filters.

decision.zh: Jev Noul 批量判断每行是否符合条件，代码读取概率并按可配置阈值筛选；默认阈值 0.8。
decision.en: Batched Jev Nouls judge each row against the condition. Code reads probabilities and applies a configurable threshold, defaulting to 0.8.

action.zh: 缓存条件与文本对应的评分，显示通过阈值的表格行及可选评分列；大量未评分行会先让用户确认。
action.en: Caches condition/text scores and displays passing rows with an optional score column, asking for confirmation before large unscored sets.

boundary.zh: MIT 社区插件，真实 TypeSafe 调用与过滤消费可查。本站未安装插件、运行 API 或复现作者演示的速度、成本与匹配质量。
boundary.en: MIT community plugin with inspectable TypeSafe calls and score consumption. This site did not install it, call the API or reproduce author demo timing, cost or match quality.

title.zh: README Clew：分类声明后交给代码核验
title.en: README Clew: classify claims before deterministic verification

input.zh: README 的分段行、候选符号名及仓库依赖/文件快照。
input.en: Segmented README lines, candidate symbol names and repository dependency/file snapshots.

decision.zh: Jev 经 Glasser 用 Choice 选有限声明类型，必要时从候选中选名称；置信度门槛拦下不确定结果。
decision.en: Jev via Glasser chooses a bounded claim type and, when necessary, a candidate name; a confidence gate retains uncertain results.

action.zh: 真实 scan 将答案交给确定性依赖、命令、环境变量和引用核验器，生成可证实、冲突或无法核验的报告；手动评测入口也调用真实模型。
action.en: The live scan passes answers to deterministic dependency, command, environment-variable and reference verifiers to build supported, contradicted or unverifiable findings; a manual evaluation entry also calls the live model.

boundary.zh: 本轮新增真实模块后收录，旧 mock 路径仍用于离线测试；完整浏览器扩展/网页仍在开发。本站未运行付费评测或证明完整产品可用。
boundary.en: Included after live modules appeared in this snapshot; mock paths remain for offline tests and the full extension/web app is still in development. Paid evaluations and complete product usability were not verified here.

title.zh: Attention Vaccine：在阅读时提示可疑写作手法
title.en: Attention Vaccine: writing-technique cues while reading

input.zh: 用户许可站点中可见的帖子正文或文章开头，受长度限制，以及有限的写作手法问题。
input.en: Length-limited visible post text or article openings on permitted sites, with bounded writing-technique questions.

decision.zh: Jev 批量 Noul 判断煽动、诈骗式引导或无依据泛化等写法；代码结合每项阈值与确定性检查。
decision.en: Batched Jev Nouls assess wording such as inflammatory cues, scam-style inducements or unsupported generalizations, combined with per-check thresholds and deterministic checks.

action.zh: 扩展为符合条件的内容添加提示标记，用户可查看问题原文、概率与说明；缓存和每日调用上限控制重复与预算。
action.en: The extension adds cues to matching content, exposing original questions, probabilities and explanations on user interaction, with caching and daily call limits.

boundary.zh: 这是写法判断，不是内容真伪验证；启用的站点文字会发往模型后端。本站未安装扩展、运行 API 或复现作者评测，权限排除逻辑也未做独立隐私审计。
boundary.en: Judges wording rather than factual truth; text on enabled sites is sent to a model backend. The extension, API, author evaluations and permission-exclusion privacy behavior were not independently tested here.

title.zh: Heliotrope：家电重要度评分辅助负载排序
title.en: Heliotrope: appliance importance scores assist load ranking

input.zh: 家电名称与类型、功率、预计完成时间和可延后窗口。
input.en: Appliance names and kinds, power, completion deadlines and flexibility windows.

decision.zh: 一批 Jev Score 按有限等级判断各负载对家庭的重要度；代码只采用达到置信度门槛的答案。
decision.en: Batched Jev Scores rate household importance against a finite rubric; code uses answers only when they meet a confidence gate.

action.zh: 代码将重要度与紧迫性、功率和弹性组合排序，输出供调度使用的优先级；模型缺失、失败或低置信度明确标示 heuristic/mixed。
action.en: Code combines importance with urgency, power and flexibility to rank loads for scheduling, explicitly labeling heuristic/mixed results on missing, failed or low-confidence model paths.

boundary.zh: 数学调度约束由代码负责；项目碳强度是代理估计。本站未调用模型、控制家电、验收电表数据或复现作者节能/减排效果。
boundary.en: Mathematical scheduling constraints remain in code and project carbon intensity is a proxy estimate. Model calls, appliance control, meter data and energy/emissions savings were not validated here.

title.zh: ToolDiscoveryBench：选择 MCP 工具或弃权
title.en: ToolDiscoveryBench: choose an MCP tool or abstain

input.zh: 任务请求、有限工具目录、服务说明与工具描述。
input.en: A task request, finite tool catalog, server descriptions and tool descriptions.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 从工具或服务候选中选择并返回概率；加入 NONE 或独立适配问题时，代码按同题概率判断是否弃权。
decision.en: Jev Choices return probabilities over tool/server candidates. With NONE or a separate fit question, code compares probabilities within the same question to decide abstention.

action.zh: 平面、因子化或分层路由输出排序与弃权结果，评测器与基线比较并生成报告；不直接执行所选工具。
action.en: Flat, factored or hierarchical routers return rankings and abstention for evaluation against baselines and reports, without directly executing selected tools.

boundary.zh: 只测工具发现，不证明 Agent 完整成功率；gold 由编码助手挑选。作者准确率、延迟与费用未由本站复现，其他后端结果不混称 Jev。
boundary.en: Measures discovery rather than complete agent success; gold tools were picked by coding assistants. Author accuracy, latency and cost were not reproduced, and other backends are not reported as Jev.

title.zh: csgojev：从状态机的合法动作中选择游戏下一步
title.en: csgojev: choose the next game move from legal state-machine actions

input.zh: 游戏感知到的距离、视线、脚步、生命值和时间，以及 XState 当前提供的合法动作。
input.en: Game observations including distance, sight, footsteps, health and time, with legal actions currently offered by XState.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 从合法候选中选择下一步，例如探出、停止、退回或等待；代码检查答案是否属于候选。
decision.en: A Jev Choice selects a next move such as peeking, stopping, retreating or waiting; code checks that the answer belongs to the offered set.

action.zh: TypeScript sidecar 把所选动作交给状态机与游戏引擎，后者负责移动、瞄准和物理；结果与其他策略基线比较。
action.en: A TypeScript sidecar passes the selection to the state machine and game engine, which own movement, aim and physics, with comparisons against other policies.

boundary.zh: 无 key 时为 mock；作者明确未证明胜过最佳手工脚本。本站未运行游戏或模型，速度/胜率是作者自报；完整仓库许可未确认，未列入开源项目目录。
boundary.en: Uses mocks without a key, and the author has not shown superiority over the best hand-written script. Game/model runs and author timing/win rates were not reproduced. Whole-repository licensing is unconfirmed, so it is not listed as an open-source project.

title.zh: question-kit：让封闭判断驱动披萨店点单流程
title.en: question-kit: closed judgments drive a pizza-counter workflow

area.zh: 流程型服务 Agent 示例

input.zh: 点单、改单、菜单询问等对话，以及有限菜单、订单记录、工具与书面步骤。
input.en: Order/change/menu conversations with a finite menu, order records, tools and written procedure steps.

decision.zh: Jev 读取有限意图、菜单/订单候选、所需槽位和确认；未达置信度门槛的读取交给追问或人工，而不直接执行。
decision.en: Jev reads bounded intents, menu/order candidates, required slots and confirmations, with uncertain readings routed to clarification or handoff instead of immediate action.

action.zh: 代码按流程返回工具调用；示例收银台修改订单后回报结果，回复由模板生成，不使用生成模型编写对话。
action.en: Code follows the procedure and returns tool calls; the example register updates the order and reports results, with replies rendered from templates rather than a generative model.

boundary.zh: alpha 库，模拟收银台并非真实支付或厨房接线；fake/replay 明确区分真实 Jev。本站未运行示例、API 或复测订单正确率。
boundary.en: An alpha library with a simulated register rather than real payment or kitchen wiring; fake/replay modes distinguish live Jev. Demo/API runs and order accuracy were not reproduced here.

title.zh: DeciLabel：按证据添加 Issue 与 PR 标签
title.en: DeciLabel: add Issue and PR labels supported by evidence

input.zh: Issue/PR 标题、正文、有界 diff 与覆盖警告、仓库既有标签和已占用互斥组。
input.en: Issue/PR titles, bodies, bounded diffs with coverage warnings, existing repository labels and occupied exclusive groups.

decision.zh: 独立标签各问 Noul，互斥组用带 none 的 Choice；代码检查概率、默认 0.70 阈值与至少 0.20 的胜出差距，缺失/异常则弃权。
decision.en: Independent labels receive Nouls and exclusive groups receive Choices with none; code checks probabilities, the default 0.70 threshold and a 0.20 winning margin, abstaining on missing or malformed answers.

action.zh: 写入前重新读取快照、标签定义和人工移除历史；通过后仅添加标签，不删除、替换或创建，也不运行提交者代码。
action.en: Rechecks item snapshots, label definitions and maintainer-removal history before adding labels only, without deleting, replacing, creating labels or running contributor code.

boundary.zh: 真实 API 接线可查，但作者明确未 live 验证模型质量，24 个示例不是校准证明；GitHub 历史检查与添加并非原子。本站未安装 Action 或修改任何外部条目的标签。
boundary.en: Real API wiring is inspectable, but the author explicitly lacks live quality verification and 24 examples do not establish calibration. GitHub history checks and additions are not atomic; this site did not install the Action or alter external labels.

title.zh: depgate：依赖更新的合并、复核与暂缓判断
title.en: depgate: dependency-update merge, review and hold decisions

input.zh: Dependabot/Renovate 更新的发布说明、代码用法、CI 状态和安全公告。
input.en: Release notes, repository usage, CI status and advisories for Dependabot/Renovate updates.

decision.zh: 一次 Jev 请求包含三分流 Choice、风险 Score 与四个 Noul，判断破坏性变化、是否影响仓库、安全修复和运行时变化。
decision.en: One Jev request asks a triage Choice, risk Score and four Nouls about breaking changes, repository impact, security fixes and runtime changes.

action.zh: 代码再按配置、置信度、风险、CI 与版本约束决定评论、标签和人工复核；允许自动合并时可批准并开启 GitHub auto-merge，dry-run 不写入。
action.en: Code applies configuration, confidence, risk, CI and version constraints for comments, labels and review; eligible configured paths can approve and enable GitHub auto-merge, while dry-run does not write.

boundary.zh: 作者评测和团队故事不作本站验证的生产效果或安全保证。本站未调用 Jev、接入用户仓库、发送通知或执行任何批准/合并。
boundary.en: Author evaluations and team stories are not independently verified production outcomes or safety guarantees. This site did not call Jev, connect user repositories, send notifications or perform approvals/merges.

title.zh: skimmer：只保留对目标有用的原文与列表项
title.en: skimmer: keep source chunks and list items relevant to a goal

input.zh: 目标说明、网页或文件的重叠文本块，以及原格式列表项。
input.en: A goal, overlapping chunks from pages/files and original-format list items.

decision.zh: 每块或每项一个 Jev Noul 相关性问题，按上下文预算分批，代码解析 P(相关) 并用可配置阈值筛选。
decision.en: One Jev Noul relevance question per chunk/item, batched to context budgets, with code parsing relevance probabilities against configurable thresholds.

action.zh: 输出保留的原文、路径与行号，或按输入格式和顺序返回列表；部分失败的未判项默认保留，全请求失败报告错误。
action.en: Returns kept source text with paths/line ranges or lists in their original format/order; unjudged items from partial failures are kept by default, while total request failure reports an error.

boundary.zh: 原文保留不保证召回；可选上限会再次裁剪，未判块也可能被排除。作者压缩率与质量未复现，本站未把真实工作材料发往模型。
boundary.en: Verbatim preservation does not guarantee recall, and optional caps can trim even unjudged chunks. Author savings/quality were not reproduced and real workspace materials were not sent to the model here.

title.zh: QQ：在已授权模型与推理强度中选择任务路线
title.en: QQ: route tasks among authorized models and reasoning efforts

area.zh: 编码 Agent 模型路由

input.zh: 有界脱敏任务，以及当前配置、授权和认证可用的模型/推理强度元数据。
input.en: A bounded masked task with configured, authorized and authenticated model/effort metadata.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 从最多 32 个模型/强度组合中选择；代码同时检查合法候选、响应合同、置信度和胜出概率，后两项门槛均 0.7。
decision.en: A Jev Choice selects from at most 32 model/effort combinations, with code validating candidates, response contracts, confidence and winning probability; the latter gates are both 0.7.

action.zh: 主运行时重编译并校验所选路线后执行；未开启、超时、异常、不确定或路线不可用时保留原配置模型，明确选择仍由用户掌握。
action.en: The runtime recompiles and validates a selected route before execution, retaining the configured model when disabled, timed out, malformed, uncertain or unavailable, while honoring explicit selections.

boundary.zh: 可选路由默认关闭；今日定位了实际 TypeSafe POST 与主运行时接线，关闭此前未核实线索。本站未运行 Agent 或证明任务质量、费用节省及完整审批安全。
boundary.en: Optional routing is disabled by default. The actual TypeSafe POST and runtime wiring were located today, resolving a previously unverified lead. Agent runs, task quality, savings and full approval safety were not independently validated.

title.zh: 官方记忆示例：保存客户事实辅助后续工单路由
title.en: Official memory example: customer facts assist later ticket routing

input.zh: 当前工单、客户 ID 和该客户已保存的工单/答案。
input.en: A current ticket, customer ID and previously saved tickets/answers for that customer.
