decision.zh: Jev Noul 判断各卡片是否当前可行动，Choice 在有限卡片与none中选择；解码门槛拒绝不确定或不支持的结果。
decision.en: Jev Noul judges whether cards are currently actionable and Choice selects among the bounded cards and none; decoding thresholds reject uncertain or unsupported answers.

action.zh: 消费者将合格结果排序展示在教练面板；可信none可不发卡片。模型关闭、迟到、失败或置信度不足时回退确定性优先级，不阻塞事件循环。
action.en: The consumer ranks and displays accepted results on the coach board; a confident none can suppress a card. Off, late, failed or low-confidence model results fall back to deterministic priorities without blocking the event loop.

boundary.zh: MIT社区代码；已核原生SDK、模型/离线模式分离与实际消费者，未接摄像头、运行比赛或调用模型。模拟/回放测试和作者测试数不证明真实篮球识别或教练建议准确率；README与实现的时间预算口径不同，本文不复述其延迟指标。
boundary.en: MIT community code. Native SDK wiring, live/offline-mode separation and the consumer were reviewed without cameras, game execution or model calls. Simulated/replay tests and author test counts do not establish real-game recognition or advice accuracy. README and implementation timing budgets differ, so no latency claim is repeated.

title.zh: FFT 反馈的九问题分析与人工复核队列
title.en: Nine-question FFT feedback analysis and human review queues

input.zh: Google Sheet 中 FFT 反馈的 free_text 与 do_better，合并后去空/短文本、匿名化并建立稳定复核标识。
input.en: FFT free_text and do_better fields from a Google Sheet, combined, filtered for empty/short text, anonymized and assigned a stable review identifier.

decision.zh: 作者用一次 Jev 调用的9个独立问题：Choice 判情绪、主题与人员组，Score 判程度/行动性/紧急度，Noul 判安全、尊严/包容及离开风险。
decision.en: The author uses nine independent Jev questions per review: Choice for sentiment/topic/staff group, Score for strength/actionability/urgency, and Noul for safety, dignity/inclusion and leaving risk.

action.zh: 异步批处理把答案与概率存 CSV、定期检查点续做；Streamlit 读取持久结果，按代码规则显示警示与低置信度候选主题，供人员复核，浏览页面时不重新推理。
action.en: An async batch job persists answers/probabilities to CSV with checkpoints. Streamlit reads stored results and uses code rules for alerts and low-confidence alternative topics for staff review, without inference on page views.

boundary.zh: 作者公开文章和展示代码已读，未核原仓、根许可或处理任何患者记录；不是NHS官方背书或临床诊断。阈值未有本站校准，匿名化有效性/部署效果未复测；分数落盘取整会损失信息，jev-latest别名可能变化。
boundary.en: The author’s public article and displayed code were reviewed, not the original repository/license or any patient records. No NHS endorsement or clinical diagnosis is implied. Thresholds, anonymization and deployed effects were not independently validated; integer score storage loses information and the jev-latest alias can change.

title.zh: WhatsApp 分类的影子运行与分歧复盘
title.en: Shadow classification and disagreement review on WhatsApp

input.zh: 与主客服流程并行的一份文本历史和预订上下文；不含主流程全部运行信息或图像像素。
input.en: A parallel copy of text history and booking context, excluding some operational information and image pixels available to the main support pipeline.

decision.zh: Jev 1.13.0 判断报价、投诉、付款等有限意图，并回答求职、需人工及是否明确确认方案等二元问题；问题版本分别记录。
decision.en: Jev 1.13.0 classifies finite intents such as quotation, complaint and payment, plus binary questions about job seeking, human review and explicit proposal confirmation, with rubric versions separated.

action.zh: 只记录标签、概率、延迟和错误，与主流程结果作分层对照，供后续独立标注与评估；不改变客户回复、不创建预订，也不据此自动接管服务。
action.en: It logs labels, probabilities, latency and errors for stratified comparison and later independent labeling; it does not change customer replies, create bookings or automatically take over service.

boundary.zh: 文章标10月2日、10月22日原帖再次分享；作者703个turn含重复联系人，模型间一致率不是人工准确率。128/131仅指主提供商失败子集中的返回率，不是纠错率；两者共用基础设施，费用/延迟口径不同，尚未证明业务收益或独立容灾，未读客户对话或复测。
boundary.en: The article is dated October 2 and was reshared October 22. The author’s 703 turns include repeat contacts, and agreement is not human-labeled accuracy. 128/131 is response availability in a provider-failure subset, not correctness. Shared infrastructure and different cost/timing scopes preclude claims of business gains or independent redundancy. No customer conversations were read or experiment rerun.

title.zh: 王者荣耀中的有限动作与赛后 Playbook 迭代
title.en: Bounded game actions and post-game playbook refinement

input.zh: 己方可见的英雄状态、当前规划与此刻允许的决策集合；教练赛后可见完整记录，场上模型不获该全局视角。
input.en: The hero’s visible state, current plan and currently available decisions; the coach receives complete post-game records, while playing models do not.

decision.zh: Jev 在有限决策空间返回各选项概率并选择动作；较大的 Agnes 模型另作规划和赛后策略改写。
decision.en: Jev returns probabilities over bounded decisions and chooses an action, while larger Agnes models plan and revise the playbook after games.

action.zh: Playbook代码高频执行动作；教练提议提示、动作空间与反射代码改动，经固定测试后才晋升候选，模型权重不训练。
action.en: Playbook code executes actions at a higher frequency; coach-proposed prompt, action-space and reflex-code changes pass fixed promotion tests, without model-weight training.

boundary.zh: 仅作者10月12日报告，仓库无可运行核心代码或已核根许可，不列开源项目。胜率/延迟为作者自报且仅对内置机器人；95%检查分数不是纯胜率，3v3后续虚线是目标，部分迁移含人工操作，不能推广到真人竞技或机器人。
boundary.en: Author report dated October 12 only, with no runnable core or verified root license, so no open-source-project entry. Win rates/latency are author-reported against built-in bots; a 95% check score is not a pure win rate, future 3v3 dashed points are targets and some transfer was manual. No extension to human competition or robotics is established.

title.zh: UiPath 预览连接器的有界判断与阈值复核
title.en: Bounded judgments and threshold review with the UiPath preview connector

input.zh: UiPath 工作流提供的 JSON 状态、预先定义的选项或有序准则；供应商展示邮件路由等决策活动。
input.en: JSON state supplied by a UiPath workflow with predefined options or ordered criteria; the vendor illustrates decision activities such as email routing.

decision.zh: 连接器以用户自己的 TypeSafe Key 调用 Jev 的 Choice、Score、Noul，返回结构化答案、概率及适用的置信度。
decision.en: The connector calls Jev Choice, Score and Noul with the user’s own TypeSafe key, returning typed answers, probabilities and confidence where applicable.

action.zh: 工作流代码消费答案并配置任务阈值，清楚的结果进入后续步骤，低于门槛则转人工或推理 Agent 复核；模型本身不授权业务动作。
action.en: Workflow code consumes answers and task-specific thresholds, continuing suitable results and handing uncertain ones to humans or reasoning agents; the model itself does not authorize business actions.

boundary.zh: 已核UiPath一手文章与TypeSafe推荐，明确为preview和供应商示例，未登录租户执行或验证客户生产闭环。94%是与LLM裁判的一致率，成本/延迟为早期内部评测，非本站实测；请求走用户与TypeSafe的约定，不经UiPath AI Trust Layer。
boundary.en: UiPath’s primary article and TypeSafe’s recommendation were verified. This is a preview/vendor example, not a tenant execution or verified customer production loop. The 94% figure measures LLM-judge agreement; cost/latency come from early internal experiments, not our tests. Requests use the user’s TypeSafe agreement and bypass UiPath AI Trust Layer.

title.zh: 申诉分流原型：23 个判断交给版本化政策
title.en: Grievance triage prototype with 23 judgments and versioned policy

input.zh: 开发项目申诉文本、接收日期和渠道；本轮只检查公开源码。
input.en: A development-project grievance, receipt date and channel; only public source code was inspected.

decision.zh: 一次原生 System One 请求以 Noul 判断项目、议题与安全信号，以 Score 判断紧急程度；日期窗口由 Python 计算。
decision.en: One native System One call uses Noul for project, issue and safety signals and Score for urgency; Python computes date windows.

action.zh: 版本化阈值与 P1–P8 规则输出部门、紧急程度、脱敏和复核标记；安全风险、不确定结果或 API 失败进入人工复核，清晰常规项才建议自动分流。
action.en: Versioned thresholds and P1–P8 rules produce department, urgency, redaction and review fields. Safety risks, uncertainty or API failures go to human review; clear routine items may be auto-routed.

boundary.zh: Apache-2.0 社区原型，非真实申诉处置系统验收。未读取投诉缓存、运行模型或验证安全召回/可靠脱敏；其样本评估是作者自报，不应自动裁定个人权益。
boundary.en: Apache-2.0 community prototype, not an accepted real grievance-handling system. No complaint caches read, model calls run or safety recall/redaction verified. Sample evaluation is author-reported and does not authorize decisions about personal rights.

title.zh: Flutter 语义测试：从有限动作到独立断言
title.en: Flutter semantic testing from bounded actions to independent assertions

input.zh: 调试版 Flutter 的语义节点、目标、未满足断言及输入字段说明；具体输入值保留本地。
input.en: Semantic nodes from a debug Flutter app, a goal, unmet assertions and input-field descriptions; actual input values stay local.

decision.zh: 原生 Jev Choice 从执行器构造的 tap、fill、wait、blocked 等有限候选中选择下一步，并返回置信度。
decision.en: A native Jev Choice selects the next step from executor-built tap, fill, wait and blocked candidates, returning confidence.

action.zh: 执行器校验候选与置信度，动作前重读界面，调用 Marionette，并重新检查断言；界面漂移、低置信度、无语义变化或步数耗尽会停止。
action.en: The executor validates candidate and confidence, reobserves before acting, calls Marionette and independently checks assertions. UI drift, low confidence, no semantic change or step exhaustion stop the run.

boundary.zh: 未安装应用、启动模拟器或调用模型；作者的 19/19 断言和耗时不是本站实测。需应用实现调试语义接口，不能直接测试任意 release APK；未发现根许可证，只列代码案例。
boundary.en: No app installed, emulator started or model called. The author’s 19/19 assertions and timings are not our measurements. App-specific debug semantics are required; arbitrary release APKs are unsupported. No root license found, so this is a code case only.

name: Decision models for industrial image QC
author: Fadel M. Megahed / Ying-Ju Chen

title.zh: 工业图像质检：有界分类与独立校准
title.en: Industrial image inspection with bounded classification and held-out calibration

input.zh: 待检工业图像、正常/缺陷描述及可选的已标注参考图像。
input.en: An industrial inspection image, normal/defect descriptions and optional labeled reference images.

decision.zh: 托管 TypeSafe 路径发送图像 assets 和实验性图像请求头，用 Choice 判断正常/缺陷或主要缺陷，也提供多标签 Noul。
decision.en: The hosted TypeSafe path sends image assets and the experimental image header, using Choice for normal/defective or primary-defect classification, with an optional multi-label Noul mode.

action.zh: R 代码整理概率与预测，另以校准集拟合 Platt/保序回归，并对保留测试集按阈值评估，输出配对比较和报告。
action.en: R code produces probabilities and predictions, fits Platt/isotonic calibration on calibration data and evaluates held-out test images with thresholds, producing paired comparisons and reports.

boundary.zh: MIT 研究工程，R 包仍在设计；另有独立本地模型路径，不能当 TypeSafe 权重开源。论文数值与成本为作者自报，未下载数据/权重、运行付费评测或验证工厂部署，数据集另有许可边界。
boundary.en: MIT research project; the R package remains in design. A separate local-model path does not make TypeSafe weights open. Paper metrics/costs are author-reported; no data/weights downloaded, paid evaluation run or factory deployment verified. Dataset licenses are separate.

title.zh: Obsidian 笔记的封闭分类与低置信度确认
title.en: Bounded Obsidian note classification with confirmation for uncertain pairs

input.zh: 用户主动触发的笔记标题、标签和截断正文；排除目录先于读取检查。
input.en: A user-triggered note title, tags and truncated body; excluded folders are checked before reading.

decision.zh: 一次原生 Jev 请求用 Choice 选择固定知识领域及其子类；代码拒绝分类表外的返回值，并用类别与子类概率组合判断是否需要确认。
decision.en: One native Jev request uses Choice for fixed knowledge categories and subcategories. Code rejects values outside the taxonomy and combines category/subcategory probabilities to decide whether confirmation is needed.

action.zh: 低于门槛时弹窗让用户选前三组合，已有分类先确认覆盖；通过后写入 categoria/genero frontmatter。另有封闭词表主题标签命令。
action.en: Below threshold, a modal asks the user to choose among the top three pairs; existing classifications require overwrite confirmation. Accepted pairs update categoria/genero frontmatter, with a separate closed-wordlist tag command.

boundary.zh: 0BSD 社区插件；未安装 Obsidian 插件、发送笔记或验证上架。笔记片段会离机，默认阈值是作者设置，不是准确率保证。
boundary.en: 0BSD community plugin. No plugin installed, notes sent or marketplace availability verified. Note excerpts leave the device; the default threshold is an author setting, not an accuracy guarantee.

title.zh: Switchbite：候选工作者排序与显式暂缓
title.en: Switchbite worker ranking and explicit holds

input.zh: 宿主提供的任务、能力要求、候选工作者、可用性和偏好。
input.en: Host-supplied task, capability requirements, candidate workers, availability and preferences.

decision.zh: 先用代码排除不合格候选，再以 Jev 1.14 Noul 判断上下文充分性，Score 评估每个候选的适配与偏好；代码按 0.7/0.3 加权。
decision.en: Code filters ineligible candidates, then Jev 1.14 Noul checks context sufficiency and Score judges fit/preferences for each candidate; code combines them with 0.7/0.3 weights.

action.zh: 严格校验答案后返回 assign 建议或带理由的 hold；宿主负责权限、启动、状态与实际编排，MCP 服务自身不启动工作者。
action.en: After strict answer validation, returns an assign proposal or a reasoned hold. The host owns authorization, dispatch, state and orchestration; the MCP server itself launches no workers.

boundary.zh: MIT 首个公开预览；仅作者声明 Windows x64 发布验收，macOS/Linux 未发布验收。未运行二进制或真实模型；离线 replay 优先且需要宿主绑定原任务，置信度是分布集中度。
boundary.en: MIT first public preview. The author validates only Windows x64 release builds, not macOS/Linux. No binary or live model run. Offline replays take precedence and must be bound to original tasks by the host; confidence measures distribution concentration.

title.zh: Perch：以 Jev 概率生成语义代码检查结果
title.en: Perch semantic code checks driven by Jev probabilities

input.zh: 解析出的代码方法、相关调用上下文及可配置的自然语言规则。
input.en: Parsed code methods, related call context and configurable natural-language rules.

decision.zh: 可配置的原生 TypeSafe System One 路径使用 jev-latest，对代码和规则提封闭问题；缺失答案会报错，超限请求按服务限制拆分。
decision.en: The configurable native TypeSafe System One path uses jev-latest for bounded code/rule questions, rejects missing answers and splits requests to service limits.

action.zh: 代码把概率转换为问题、严重度和规则违例列表，保存扫描覆盖与失败状态，用于排序、复查及 CI 门槛；未完整检查不应当作通过。
action.en: Code converts probabilities into issue/severity and rule-violation lists, preserving coverage and failures for ranking, rechecks and CI gates; incomplete checks must not be treated as passes.

boundary.zh: MIT 多后端工具，默认 Perch Cloud 路由不等于每次都用 Jev；需显式配置 TypeSafe。基准同时含 OpenAI 和 Jev，不能把另一模型成绩归给 Jev；未上传仓库或复测缺陷召回。
boundary.en: MIT multi-backend tool. Default Perch Cloud routing does not imply every call uses Jev; TypeSafe must be configured explicitly. Benchmarks include OpenAI and Jev, and one model’s results must not be attributed to the other. No repository uploaded or defect recall retested.

name: Sanity @s agent harness
author: Even Westvang / Rostislav Melkumyan / Knut Melvær

title.zh: Sanity @s：公司 Agent 路由与前三项人工选择
title.en: Sanity @s company-agent routing with a top-three user fallback

area.zh: 企业内部 Agent 路由

input.zh: Slack 当前消息（最多 8,000 字符）、最多前 20 条线程消息，以及已发布可路由 Agent 的描述；作者当时有 66 项和一个 @s 帮助选项。
input.en: The current Slack message (up to 8,000 characters), up to 20 prior thread messages and descriptions of published routable agents; the author reports 66 agents plus an @s help option.

decision.zh: Jev 在给定候选中判断相关性和置信度，并获知线程当前 Agent；在自动响应频道另判断该 Agent 是否应答。
decision.en: Jev judges relevance/confidence among supplied candidates with the current thread agent identified; watched channels separately ask whether the agent should reply.

action.zh: 最高概率候选接手任务；置信度低于 0.4 时展示前三项让用户选择。后续工具与知识库由选中 Agent 执行，Temporal 保持运行。
action.en: The highest-probability agent gets the task; below 0.4 confidence, the user chooses among the top three. The selected agent uses its tools/knowledge bases, with Temporal providing durable execution.

boundary.zh: Sanity 一手工程文章、作者原帖及 TypeSafe 推荐已核；这是社区公司的内部实现，不是 TypeSafe 官方项目。未获得内部源码、Slack 权限或独立准确率；0.4 是作者策略。
boundary.en: Sanity’s primary engineering article, author post and TypeSafe recommendation were verified. This is a community company’s internal implementation, not a TypeSafe official project. No internal code, Slack access or independent accuracy evidence; 0.4 is the author’s policy.

title.zh: Composio Firewall：工具调用与返回值的条件拦截
title.en: Composio Firewall condition checks on tool calls and results

input.zh: 工具名、参数、返回内容及用户配置的自然语言阻止条件；有历史上下文的会话也会考虑此前活动。
input.en: Tool name, arguments, returned content and user-defined blocking conditions; sessions with historical context also consider prior activity.

decision.zh: 作者说明 Firewall 结合 Jev 与 Composio 自定义小模型评估行动和输入；文档展示条件是否命中及提示注入检查，未公开每个检查的模型分工或题型。
decision.en: The author says Firewall combines Jev and Composio-tuned small models to assess actions and incoming information. Docs show condition matching and injection checks, without exposing per-check model allocation or primitives.

action.zh: before_execute 命中条件时不执行调用并返回 blocked；after_execute 可阻止结果进入 Agent，注入检查只作用于返回值。
action.en: A matching before_execute check prevents the call and returns blocked; after_execute can withhold results from the agent, with injection checks limited to tool results.

boundary.zh: 供应商文档标 Experimental、付费计划；营销页部分上下文功能仍标 Coming soon，不能概括为全部已上线。after_execute 不能撤销已执行工具，ZDR 缺少历史上下文，meta tools 不在 hook 范围。未开通服务、调用 API 或独立验证攻防效果。
boundary.en: Vendor docs mark this experimental and available on paid plans; some contextual features remain marked Coming soon on the marketing page, so universal availability is not claimed. after_execute cannot undo execution, ZDR lacks historical context, and meta tools are outside hooks. No service activated, API called or security efficacy tested.

title.zh: XERJ：本地检索后的可选 Jev 重排
title.en: Optional Jev reranking after local XERJ retrieval

input.zh: 本地检索的问题与窗口内命中项的标题、文本及显式允许字段；无文本项不外发。
input.en: A local-search query plus titles, text and explicitly permitted fields from a hit window; blank items are not sent.

decision.zh: 托管 Jev 路径为每篇候选构造独立 Noul，把候选内容放入该问题的 instructions，判断是否能回答查询。
decision.en: The hosted Jev path builds an independent Noul per candidate, placing its document in that question’s instructions to judge relevance to the query.

action.zh: API 层以有效答案重排并替换 _score，记录未评估项；可降级错误明确返回 applied:false 并保留原排序，其他错误按策略上报。
action.en: The API stage reorders by valid answers, replaces _score and records unjudged hits. Degradable failures explicitly report applied:false and retain engine order; other errors follow the stated policy.

boundary.zh: Apache-2.0 社区引擎；重排需显式请求且把问题/命中文本外发。作者提示原始概率未校准，勿把同一阈值当跨查询可靠性。另有本地 judge/兼容端点，不能算托管 Jev；未安装、上传索引或复测 BEIR 指标。
boundary.en: Apache-2.0 community engine. Explicit rerank requests send the query/hit text out. Authors warn that raw probabilities are uncalibrated, so thresholds are not cross-query reliability guarantees. Separate local judges/compatible endpoints are not hosted Jev. No installation, index upload or BEIR retest.

title.zh: 中文内容审核评测：四个问题与固定阈值
title.en: Chinese moderation evaluation with four questions and fixed thresholds

input.zh: 作者从公开数据标签映射构建的 825 条中文评测样本；本轮只读取方法和程序，不读取样本文本。
input.en: An author-built 825-item Chinese evaluation set mapped from public dataset labels; only methods and code were read, not sample text.

decision.zh: 选择 jev provider 时调用 TypeSafe System One；Choice 选有限类别，Score 评严重度，两个 Noul 判断攻击和危害信号。
decision.en: Selecting the jev provider calls TypeSafe System One: Choice selects a bounded category, Score rates severity and two Nouls detect attack/harm signals.

action.zh: 程序按类别概率与固定门槛合成 verdict，在 CLI/网页汇总混淆矩阵、F1 和延迟，区分真实 provider 与 mock；不实际封禁用户内容。
action.en: Code combines class probabilities and fixed thresholds into a verdict, reporting confusion matrices, F1 and latency in CLI/web views, with real providers distinguished from mock; it does not ban user content.

boundary.zh: MIT 评测工程，数据许可独立。Jev preview 的结果为作者自报；标签并非独立人工复核，违规占比偏高，不能外推线上误杀率。无 Key 可进明确标记的 mock；未调用 API 或复跑评测。
boundary.en: MIT evaluation project with separate data licenses. Jev preview results are author-reported; mapped labels are not independently reviewed and the high violation share limits production inference. A labeled mock mode is available without a key. No API calls or evaluation reruns.

title.zh: 榴莲评论研究：18 项判断到品种比较
title.en: Durian opinion research from 18 judgments to variety comparisons

input.zh: 83 条中、英、马来文榴莲评论片段及三种品种、口味等固定问题定义。
input.en: 83 Chinese, English and Malay durian-opinion excerpts and fixed definitions for varieties, taste aspects and other questions.

decision.zh: 原生托管 Jev 对每条评论回答 18 个 Noul、Choice、Score 问题，识别提及、情绪、品种和比较等；独立本地模型另走 Ollama。
decision.en: Native hosted Jev answers 18 Noul, Choice and Score questions per opinion for mentions, sentiment, variety and comparisons; separate local models use Ollama.

action.zh: Python 归一化答案，与标签比较质量、耗时和成本，再把评分及比较结果转成 Elo 表与图表。
action.en: Python normalizes answers, compares quality/time/cost against labels and converts ratings/comparisons into Elo tables and charts.

boundary.zh: MIT 研究代码，评论版权属于原作者。小样本、作者选择和 Elo 构造限制结论；排行榜及费用为作者自报，非客观品种优劣或本站实测。未搬运评论、运行 notebook、下载模型或付费评测。
boundary.en: MIT research code; opinion copyrights remain with original authors. Small samples, author selection and Elo construction limit conclusions. Rankings/costs are author-reported, not objective variety quality or our measurements. No excerpts copied, notebooks run, models downloaded or paid evaluations performed.

title.zh: Claude 草稿的模型与推理强度建议
title.en: Model and effort suggestions for Claude drafts

input.zh: 待发送草稿；只有被判断为续接先前工作时，才附最近两条用户提示和上一条助手回复的截断内容。
input.en: A draft prompt; truncated recent user prompts and the last assistant reply are attached only when judged to continue earlier work.

decision.zh: 原生 System One 格式一次问有限模型、推理强度、敏感改动、显式模型指令和续接信号；续接时按策略补上下文再判断。
decision.en: One System One-format request asks about bounded model/effort options, sensitive changes, explicit model instructions and continuation; policy may make a context-enriched follow-up.

action.zh: 代码按门槛、升档策略和用户明确选择生成建议卡，使用者手动改模型；首次发送后的建议也不代表已切换正在运行的模型。
action.en: Code applies thresholds, step-up rules and explicit user choices to show a suggestion card; users change the model manually. A first-message card does not imply the running model has changed.

boundary.zh: Apache-2.0 社区 mod，默认 Merge Gateway，TypeSafe 直连为可选配置，Kev 是独立后端。脱敏仅覆盖明显模式，非完整保密保证；作者准确率/成本未复测，未安装 mod、读取会话或调用模型。
boundary.en: Apache-2.0 community mod. Merge Gateway is default, TypeSafe direct is optional and Kev is independent. Scrubbing covers obvious patterns, not complete confidentiality. Accuracy/costs were not retested; no mod installed, sessions read or models called.

title.zh: judgelint：团队约定的双向问题与行级结果
title.en: judgelint paired convention questions and line-range results

input.zh: 带行号的代码文件、README 约定及可选上下文；默认按 40 行窗口提问。
input.en: Numbered source files, README conventions and optional context, with questions normally targeting 40-line windows.

decision.zh: TypeSafe 配置走原生 System One Noul；对约定分别问违反和遵循/不适用，再反转遵循答案，形成违规评分。
decision.en: The TypeSafe configuration uses native System One Nouls, asking whether a convention is broken and followed/inapplicable, then inverting the latter into violation scores.

action.zh: 程序合并问题/可选多模型评分，按阈值区分 violation、uncertain 等状态，输出行范围、JSON/SARIF 或 CI 退出码；跳过与拒答单独呈现。
action.en: Code combines question/optional multi-model scores, classifies violation/uncertain and other states, and emits line ranges, JSON/SARIF or CI exit codes; skipped/refused items remain explicit.

boundary.zh: MIT 多后端工具，其他模型结果不算 Jev 效果。规则措辞、judge 家族和代码内 judgehint 均影响结果；不是确定性静态证明或安全授权。未安装二进制、上传代码或复测作者样本。
boundary.en: MIT multi-backend tool; other model results are not Jev results. Rule wording, judge family and in-code judgehint comments affect outcomes. This is not deterministic proof or security authorization. No binary installed, source uploaded or author samples retested.

title.zh: AI 对话研究：用 Jev 分类而后人工选读
title.en: AI-dialogue research with Jev classification and human reading

input.zh: 作者生成的 437 组对话、11,013 条消息；本轮只读作者公开文章。
input.en: The author’s 437 generated conversation records and 11,013 messages; only the public author article was read.

decision.zh: 作者用 TypeSafe Jev 为每条消息回答 53 个分类问题，其中 24 个宽泛主题；另以六个视角评估一千条消息，具体 API primitive 未公开核实。
decision.en: The author uses TypeSafe Jev for 53 classifier questions per message, including 24 broad domains, and six lenses on 1,000 messages; exact API primitives were not verified.

action.zh: 汇总主题分布与相关性，辅助选择值得人工阅读的片段，再据偏差设计后续人工校验和控制实验。
action.en: Aggregated topic distributions and correlations help select passages for human reading and inform later validation/control experiments.

boundary.zh: 仅作者文章，未精读仓库或搬运原始对话，暂不列开源项目。主题得分不是意识证据；样本失衡、消息不独立、提示框架及长度偏差限制结论，费用为作者自报。
boundary.en: Author-article evidence only; repository code and raw conversations were not inspected/copied, so no project entry is added. Topic scores are not consciousness evidence. Imbalance, dependent messages, prompt framing and length bias limit findings; costs are author-reported.

title.zh: ADK：Jev 分类答案连接工作流分支
title.en: ADK workflow branches driven by Jev classifier answers

input.zh: 文档中的客服工单文本，或由调用方提供的 JSON；每个问题显式给出说明和允许答案。
input.en: A support-ticket text in the docs, or caller-supplied JSON, with explicit instructions and allowed answers.

decision.zh: TypesafeClassifier 将 Choice、Binary、Score 转为原生 Jev choice、noul、score，一次请求后校验类型、候选标签及数值范围。
decision.en: TypesafeClassifier converts Choice, Binary and Score to native Jev choice, noul and score, then checks types, labels and numeric ranges.

action.zh: ClassifierNode 用 Choice 标签或 Binary 阈值生成 route，原输入交给下游节点；建图时检查分支覆盖，缺失/非法答案报错。
action.en: ClassifierNode emits a Choice label or Binary-threshold route while forwarding unchanged input; graph validation checks branch coverage and invalid/missing answers raise errors.

boundary.zh: Apache-2.0 的 Google SDK 集成，不是 TypeSafe 官方项目。分类节点仍属 labs 实验接口；通用工单样例默认 Gemini，文档另给 TypesafeClassifier 替换接线。未安装、调用 Jev、执行客服或工具权限操作。
boundary.en: Apache-2.0 Google SDK integration, not a TypeSafe official project. Classifier nodes remain experimental labs APIs. The generic ticket sample defaults to Gemini; docs explicitly show TypeSafe wiring. No install, Jev call, customer workflow or tool authorization executed.

title.zh: Skillbox：只在获授权的 Skill 目录内评分推荐
title.en: Skillbox relevance recommendations within an authorized skill catalog

input.zh: 用户任务和当前身份获授权、启用且未归档的 Skill 描述与版本；超出目录预算则明确回退。
input.en: A task and the authenticated scope’s active, authorized skill descriptions/revisions; oversized catalogs explicitly fall back.

decision.zh: 可选 TypeSafe 直连为每个候选提 Score，使用 0–4 的有限相关性量表；也支持由用户配置的其他网关。
decision.en: Optional direct TypeSafe evaluates each candidate with a Score on a bounded 0–4 relevance rubric; user-configured gateways are also supported.

action.zh: 代码校验全部评分，返回至少 3 分的候选并排序分页；权限/目录变化会废弃旧结果，失败回到普通搜索并标出 fallbackReason，不执行 Skill。
action.en: Code validates all scores and returns candidates scoring at least 3, ranked/paginated. Scope/catalog changes invalidate results, failures explicitly fall back to search, and no skill is executed.

boundary.zh: MIT 自托管工具。0–4 是未校准量表而非正确率；任务和获授权描述仍发给所选服务。没有密钥/超时回退不算 Jev 成功；未安装、读取私人 Skill、付费跑分或验收生产推荐质量。
boundary.en: MIT self-hosted tool. The 0–4 rubric is uncalibrated, not accuracy. Tasks and authorized descriptions go to the selected provider. Missing-key/timeout fallback is not Jev success. No install, private-skill access, paid benchmark or production-quality validation.

title.zh: 论文日报：Jev 筛兴趣，代码排序后再生成摘要
title.en: Paper digest with Jev interest screening before ranking and summaries

input.zh: 新 arXiv 论文的标题、摘要和分类，以及用户配置的兴趣命题与排除条件。
input.en: New arXiv titles, abstracts and categories plus configured interest propositions/exclusion conditions.

decision.zh: 默认原生 TypeSafe Jev 对每篇论文批量回答兴趣与排除 Noul；校验每个答案后计算 max 或 noisy-or 组合分数。
decision.en: Native TypeSafe Jev is the default, answering interest/exclusion Nouls per paper. Validated answers become max or noisy-or composite scores.

action.zh: 程序按相关性和排除阈值筛选，另核机构偏好再取 Top K，交 DeepSeek 写摘要；预览只出报告，发送模式经待发记录和去重后投递邮件。
action.en: Code applies relevance/exclusion gates, separately checks institution preferences and selects Top K for DeepSeek summaries. Preview writes reports; send mode uses pending-delivery records and deduplication before email.

boundary.zh: MIT 工程；机构偏好和组合分数不是客观论文质量或校准概率。未调用模型、触发 Actions、发送邮件或确认真实投递；其他兼容后端只按明确配置使用，不能由接口测试推断全部真实联调。
boundary.en: MIT project. Institution preferences/composite scores are not objective paper quality or calibrated probabilities. No model calls, Actions runs, mail sending or live delivery verified. Other compatible backends require explicit configuration; contract tests do not prove all live integrations.

title.zh: Gmail 分流：证据门槛与人工纠正示例
title.en: Gmail triage with evidence gates and human-corrected examples

input.zh: 邮件发件人、主题、可选截断正文、个人偏好，以及最多六个相关人工纠正示例。
input.en: Sender, subject, optional truncated body, personal preferences and up to six relevant human-corrected examples.

decision.zh: 原生 Jev Choice 选 Spam/Ignore/Important，Noul 判断证据是否充分；代码校验分布并用概率、置信度和证据门槛决定是否 Review。
decision.en: Native Jev Choice selects Spam/Ignore/Important and Noul judges evidence sufficiency; code validates distributions and gates Review on probability, confidence and evidence.

action.zh: preview 保存预测；apply 单独校验版本和人工标签后加自定义标签。学习复用纠正示例，不训练权重；可选 cleanup 再执行归档或移入垃圾箱。
action.en: Preview stores predictions; apply separately checks versions/human labels before labeling. Learning reuses corrections without training weights; optional cleanup then archives or trashes messages.

boundary.zh: 实验性个人流程，根许可未确认，仅列代码案例。process.sh 默认启用 cleanup，Spam 移入垃圾箱，Ignore 与 Review 都会归档；复核标签不保证留在收件箱。邮件片段会外发；未读邮箱、授权 Gmail、运行分类或验证准确率。
boundary.en: Experimental personal workflow; root license unconfirmed, so code case only. process.sh enables cleanup by default: Spam goes to Trash and Ignore/Review are archived. Review does not imply inbox retention. Excerpts leave the device. No mailbox access, Gmail authorization, classification or accuracy test performed.

title.zh: Jev Live：存在判断门控的图像框快照
title.en: Jev Live image-box snapshots gated by presence judgments

input.zh: 用户主动启用后的 JPEG/PNG 快照，以及最多八个目标描述；页面加载本身不启动相机或上传。
input.en: A user-triggered JPEG/PNG snapshot with up to eight target descriptions; page load itself starts neither camera nor upload.

decision.zh: 服务端固定调用 Jev 1.14 的实验图像接口，为每个目标并行提 Noul 存在问题与 Box 定位问题。
decision.en: The server calls Jev 1.14’s experimental image interface, pairing Noul presence and Box localization questions per target.

action.zh: 代码抑制存在概率低于 0.7 或坐标/置信度无效的框，以两者最小值显示置信度；浏览器绘制快照框并在拍摄四秒后过期，迟到结果丢弃。
action.en: Code suppresses boxes below 0.7 presence or with invalid coordinates/confidence and displays the minimum confidence. Browser overlays expire four seconds after capture and late results are discarded.

boundary.zh: 未发现项目许可证，仅列公开代码案例。图像送往托管服务，并非本地视觉或连续跟踪；4 Hz 是请求目标而非完成率保证。作者测试使用虚拟相机/fixture；未打开相机、上传图像、调用模型或复测检测质量。
boundary.en: No project license found; public code case only. Images go to a hosted service, not on-device vision or continuous tracking. 4 Hz is a target cadence, not guaranteed completion rate. Author tests use fake cameras/fixtures. No camera opened, images uploaded, models called or quality retested.

title.zh: Booksmith：先逐句判断，再按段落复核停顿
title.en: Booksmith sentence decisions followed by paragraph pause review

input.zh: 作者 DRM-free 电子书中的句子边界和段落上下文，以及已测静音和可安全编辑的位置。
input.en: Sentence boundaries/paragraph context from the author’s DRM-free ebooks plus measured silence and safe edit positions.

decision.zh: 作者称 Jev 从有限停顿角色和段落方案中选择，先做句级建议，再整体保留、移除或增加节拍；不改写原文。
decision.en: The author says Jev selects bounded pause roles/paragraph plans, proposing sentence timing then retaining, removing or adding beats without rewriting the text.

action.zh: 程序把方案转换为需要增加的静音，配合本地 Kokoro 生成分章有声书；发音建议和修复另有人类批准/听感门槛。
action.en: Plans become necessary extra silence alongside local Kokoro chapter narration, with separate human approval/listening gates for pronunciation suggestions and repairs.

boundary.zh: 按作者原帖收录，非本站端到端验证。公开客户端依赖自配 /Jev/decide 网关，未核其 TypeSafe 适配；项目明确尚未选许可证，不列开源项目。Windows-first、默认关闭托管停顿功能；未读取书籍/音频、安装、调用模型或验证 Plex。
boundary.en: Author-post evidence, not our end-to-end verification. The public client needs a configured /Jev/decide gateway whose TypeSafe adapter was not verified. The project explicitly has no selected license, so no open-source entry. Windows-first, hosted timing off by default. No books/audio accessed, install, model call or Plex verification.

title.zh: 联系表单四分类与不丢邮件的失败回退
title.en: Four-way contact-form classification with fail-open mail delivery

input.zh: 表单类别、姓名、邮箱和留言，以及网站业务范围说明；本轮只读公开技术文章和脱敏示意。
input.en: Form category, name, email and message with site-business context; only the public technical article and redacted illustrations were read.

decision.zh: 一次原生 Jev Choice 在正常联系、推销、发错公司和垃圾之间分配概率；业务范围写进 instructions/criteria。
decision.en: One native Jev Choice distributes probability among legitimate inquiry, sales, misdirected and junk, with business context in instructions/criteria.

action.zh: sales+junk 至少 0.8 时加 [SPAM] 主题标记，发错公司另标；所有邮件仍发送，API 失败则按未判定正常送达。作者另做自动/手动外部垃圾报告。
action.en: At sales+junk >=0.8, code tags subjects [SPAM], with a separate misdirected tag. All mail remains delivered; API failure sends it as unclassified. The author also implements automated/manual external spam reporting.

boundary.zh: 仅作者文章，181条历史验证和单次费用为自报/估计，未验证真实计费或部署。作者披露外部自动报告与平台要求存在冲突、误报难从已分发名单收回；这部分不作为推荐流程。个人字段会外发，未读取原始客户数据、提交表单、发信或报告身份。
boundary.en: Author-article evidence only; the 181-item retrospective and per-call costs are author-reported/estimated, without independent billing or deployment verification. The author discloses conflicts with external reporting requirements and hard-to-retract distributed false reports; that portion is not a recommended workflow. Personal fields leave the device. No original customer data accessed, forms submitted, mail sent or identities reported.

title.zh: ContextGem：把协议条款提成带概率的布尔与标签
title.en: ContextGem: probability-bearing Boolean and label extraction

input.zh: 示例服务协议段落，以及终止条款、能否无因终止和通知形式等预定义概念。
input.en: Example service-agreement paragraphs and predefined concepts for termination, termination without cause and notice form.

decision.zh: typesafe/jev-latest 经 LiteLLM Decisions API 回答段落归属的 yes/no、布尔概念和有限标签问题；不是生成任意条款文本。
decision.en: Via LiteLLM Decisions, typesafe/jev-latest answers paragraph-membership predicates, Boolean concepts and closed-label questions rather than generating clause text.

action.zh: 框架按阈值筛选段落、写入布尔值和概率；单类别标签取最大概率，结果留在文档的 extracted_items 中。
action.en: The framework thresholds paragraph membership and Boolean values, retaining probabilities; multiclass labels use the most probable option and are stored in document extracted_items.

boundary.zh: Apache-2.0 社区框架，支持多供应商；0.5 默认阈值适用于相应 yes/no 判断，不能概括为所有标签的置信度门槛。示例数值属于作者演示，不是法律结论或本站实测。未安装、读取真实合同、结果日志或调用模型。
boundary.en: Apache-2.0 community framework with multiple providers. The default 0.5 threshold applies to the relevant predicates, not a universal label-confidence gate. Sample probabilities are author illustrations, not legal findings or independent measurements. No installation, real contracts, result logs or model calls.

title.zh: switch：从合法走法菜单中选择国际象棋下一步
title.en: switch: choosing the next chess move from a legal menu

input.zh: 文本棋盘、行棋历史和由 chess.js 枚举的合法走法；超出窗口时缩减历史视图。
input.en: A text board, move history and legal moves enumerated by chess.js, with a reduced history view when the window is exceeded.

decision.zh: 示例通过 pi-ai 的 typesafe/jev-latest 分类适配器，用 Choice 在合法走法和认输项之间选择，保留每项概率。
decision.en: The example uses pi-ai’s typesafe/jev-latest classifier adapter to choose a legal move or resignation with Choice, retaining option probabilities.

action.zh: 代码执行选定走法，再走带种子的随机对手回合，或让模型自弈；保存 trace、棋谱和终局，达到 200 步上限则标未完成。
action.en: Code plays the selected move followed by a seeded random opponent, or runs self-play. It records traces, moves and the outcome; reaching 200 steps is unfinished.

boundary.zh: MIT 社区框架，棋子素材另有 BSD 许可；同时支持其他决策模型。合法性由棋规库约束，不代表 Jev 棋力强或已实测胜率。未安装、下载模型、执行对局或运行文中假想工单。
boundary.en: MIT community framework with separately BSD-licensed pieces and support for other decision models. Rules constrain legal moves; this establishes no Jev playing strength or measured win rate. No installation, model downloads, games or hypothetical ticket workflow executed.

title.zh: 银行意图离线研究：比较 Choice、Noul 与模拟自动处理阈值
title.en: Banking-intent research: Choice, Noul and simulated action thresholds

input.zh: BANKING77 公开消息；七意图子集、完整 77 类，以及被排除意图的域外样本。
input.en: Public BANKING77 messages: a seven-intent slice, all 77 labels, and out-of-schema examples from excluded intents.

decision.zh: 原生 /v1/systemone 中，Choice 选意图，同次请求的独立 Noul 判断各意图；另比较简短准则和每类三个示例。
decision.en: Native /v1/systemone Choice picks an intent, with independent Nouls for individual intents in the same request; other experiments compare terse and three-shot criteria.

action.zh: 脚本对照标签计算准确率、校准和 Choice/Noul 不一致；用 0.9 阈值统计模拟自动处理比例及域外误处理，不执行银行业务。
action.en: Scripts compare labels to compute accuracy, calibration and Choice/Noul disagreement, then use 0.9 to count simulated automatic decisions and out-of-schema errors; no banking operation is performed.

boundary.zh: 代码 MIT、数据另为 CC-BY 4.0。开源 scikit-learn 仿接口与真实 Jev 实验分开；README 的数值和费用均为作者自报，阈值不是通用保证。未读取 raw 响应、访问账户、下载数据或付费重跑。
boundary.en: MIT code with separately CC-BY 4.0 data. Open scikit-learn interface experiments are distinct from actual Jev experiments. README results and costs are author-reported, and the threshold is no general guarantee. No raw responses, accounts, dataset downloads or paid reruns.

title.zh: Jev Walker：路口有限出口选择与人工覆盖原型
title.en: Jev Walker: bounded corner-exit selection with manual overrides

input.zh: 当前路口的有限出口、相对方向、街段距离、已走进度和回家罗盘；公开给模型的菜单省去原始坐标与图节点。
input.en: A bounded exit menu, relative directions, block lengths, walking progress and home compass; the public model menu omits raw coordinates and graph-node identifiers.

decision.zh: 原生 TypeSafe 或 OpenRouter Decisions 接线，用 Jev Choice 从出口编号中选择；代码检查返回编号仍在本轮菜单。
decision.en: Native TypeSafe or OpenRouter Decisions wiring uses Jev Choice over exit IDs, checking that the returned ID belongs to the current menu.

action.zh: 模拟器更新路线；手机原型显示出口并等待到达，提供“不能走”人工覆盖与结束操作，连续失败留在重试状态，不盲走下一步。
action.en: The simulator updates the route. The phone prototype displays the exit, waits for arrival and allows cannot-walk overrides or ending; repeated failures leave it waiting for retry.

boundary.zh: 公开代码但根/包许可未确认，不列许可明确的项目。README 当前完成率表是随机/启发式结果，不能写成 Jev 实走成绩；地图简化不验证实际通行安全。未读取家庭配置、GPS 日志，未定位、开隧道、实走或调用模型。
boundary.en: Public code with unconfirmed root/package licensing, so no verified-license project entry. Current README completion tables concern random/heuristic choosers, not Jev field results; simplified maps do not establish safe passage. No home configuration, GPS logs, location, tunnels, walks or model calls accessed.

title.zh: Decisium：Jev 选控件，代码检查页面值与状态
title.en: Decisium: Jev selects controls, code checks page values and states

input.zh: Gherkin 步骤、页面可见文本/控件树，以及程序枚举的元素、动作和候选输入值。
input.en: Gherkin steps, visible page text/control trees, and program-enumerated elements, actions and candidate input values.

decision.zh: 原生 jev-1.14.0 的 Choice 选择目标、动作与检查类型，Noul 判断步骤是否完成；候选过多时分批缩小。
decision.en: Native jev-1.14.0 Choice selects targets, actions and check kinds, while Noul checks step completion; large candidate sets are narrowed in batches.

action.zh: Playwright 执行动作，代码比对预期文本、值和控件状态；歧义或不可核对会另报。cassette 保存解析结果，回放不调用模型，界面变化可报 UI_CHANGED。
action.en: Playwright performs actions and code compares expected text, values and states, reporting ambiguity/unverifiability separately. Cassettes retain resolutions for model-free replay and can flag UI_CHANGED.

boundary.zh: MIT 社区工具。主观断言默认 UNVERIFIABLE，显式 --judged 才交给 Jev，结果另标，不能概括为所有断言均被代码证明。实时步骤/页面文本会外发，字面密码也可能外发，应使用 $NAME 占位；回放零调用不证明当前 Jev 效果。未安装或操作第三方站点。
boundary.en: MIT community tool. Subjective assertions default to UNVERIFIABLE; explicit --judged delegates them to Jev with separate results, so not every assertion is code-proven. Live step/page text leaves the device; literal passwords can too, so use $NAME placeholders. Model-free replay does not establish current Jev quality. No installation or third-party site actions.

title.zh: vigilant-heron：HTTP 请求先规则过滤，再用 Jev 影子审核
title.en: vigilant-heron: rules first, then Jev shadow request screening

input.zh: 固定规则未决定的 HTTP 请求副本；代码去除 Cookie/Authorization 等字段并限制正文长度，客户端内容独立放在 untrusted_http_request。
input.en: Copies of HTTP requests not decided by fixed rules, with Cookie/Authorization fields removed and body length bounded; client data is isolated under untrusted_http_request.

decision.zh: 原生 Jev 一次回答攻击概率、是否试图指挥 AI 两个 Noul，以及攻击类别 Choice；解析器检查题型和概率范围。
decision.en: One native Jev request asks two Nouls for attack and AI-directed instructions, plus a category Choice, with answer-type and probability-range checks.

action.zh: 代码按站点阈值转发、403 阻挡或跳转；shadow 只记录本会采取的动作并放行，模型失败默认放行，可配置特定路径失败关闭。
action.en: Site thresholds drive forwarding, 403 blocking or redirection. Shadow records would-have actions while forwarding; model errors default to allow, with configurable fail-closed paths.

boundary.zh: MIT 早期社区项目，作者明确未用真实流量验收，建议先 shadow。字段脱敏不能保证全部私人内容都被移除；Clef/Strands 替代后端及 e2e stub 不能当作 Jev 实测。未启动反代、发送攻击、读取真实日志或调用模型。
boundary.en: Early MIT community project explicitly unvalidated on real traffic; the author advises shadow first. Field redaction cannot guarantee all private content is removed. Alternative Clef/Strands backends and e2e stubs are not Jev measurements. No proxy launch, attacks, real logs or model calls.

title.zh: 官方 Intelliprompter：演讲要点达到覆盖分数后保持勾选
title.en: Official Intelliprompter: a monotonic checklist from coverage scores

input.zh: 持续累积的演讲转写，以及尚未勾选的要点描述；教程用六段预写转写增量演示。
input.en: An accumulated presentation transcript and descriptions of unchecked talking points; the cookbook demonstrates six authored transcript increments.

decision.zh: 每个未完成要点一个五级 Score，同一请求共享完整转写；SDK 0–4 的分数加 1 映射到界面 1–5。
decision.en: Each pending criterion gets a five-level Score over the same full transcript; adding one maps SDK scores from 0–4 to the UI’s 1–5 scale.

action.zh: 代码将至少 2.5 的要点加入已覆盖集合并从后续问题移除，清单保持勾选；Jev 不保存清单状态。
action.en: Code adds criteria scoring at least 2.5 to a covered set and omits them from later requests, preserving checks; Jev does not store checklist state.

boundary.zh: TypeSafe 官方教程；2.5 是本地覆盖阈值而非置信度，误勾不会自动撤回。教程省略麦克风/ElevenLabs 集成，以文本和缓存演示；公布数字来自作者的 jev-1.13.0 样本，未独立复现、调用麦克风或付费 API。
boundary.en: TypeSafe’s official cookbook. The 2.5 gate is a local coverage threshold, not confidence, and an incorrect check is not automatically revoked. Microphone/ElevenLabs integration is omitted in favor of text/cache replay; published numbers are the author’s jev-1.13.0 sample, not independently reproduced. No microphone or paid API calls.

title.zh: Emc²：邮件分类、相关性与固定原因标签
title.en: Emc²: mail category, relevance and fixed reason labels

input.zh: 发件地址、主题和邮件预览；命中用户发件规则时优先使用规则。
input.en: Sender address, subject and preview, with user sender rules taking priority.

decision.zh: 原生 Jev 一次用 Choice 分 Important/Other、三档 Score 评相关性，再用 Choice 选“需要回复”等固定原因。
decision.en: One native Jev request uses Choice for Important/Other, a three-level relevance Score and another Choice for fixed reasons such as needs-reply.

action.zh: 代码将 Score 0–2 取整加 1 成为显示等级，并存入本地邮件记录；服务失败保留本地排序并向用户报错，不把失败当 Jev 成功。
action.en: Code rounds the 0–2 Score and adds one for display, storing the sorting on local mail records. Provider failure retains local sorting and reports an error rather than counting as Jev success.

boundary.zh: MIT 社区邮件客户端，也支持其他供应商与离线规则。等级不是置信度；发送者和预览仍外发。未安装、连接私人邮箱、读取用户邮件或发信，作者的存储/跨平台功能未独立验收。
boundary.en: MIT community mail client with other providers and local rules. Display levels are not confidence; sender and preview still leave the device. No installation, private inbox access or mail sending; storage/platform claims were not independently tested.

title.zh: Agentic Router：将子问题分给三类知识来源
title.en: Agentic Router: routing sub-queries to three knowledge sources

input.zh: 用户问题或由另一个模型拆出的子问题；候选来源为 OpenAI 文档、两家公司 10-K 和互联网。
input.en: A user question or model-split sub-query, with OpenAI docs, two companies’ 10-K filings and the internet as candidate sources.

decision.zh: 可选 route_query_jev 用原生 SDK Choice 选三个固定来源之一，问题文本作为 state。
decision.en: Optional route_query_jev uses a native SDK Choice over three fixed sources, passing the question as state.

action.zh: 显式将 Jev router 传入后，各部分分别检索作答并合并引用；Jev 请求异常时回退互联网路线。
action.en: When the Jev router is explicitly injected, each part is retrieved/answered and its citations combined; a Jev error falls back to the internet route.

boundary.zh: 公开 notebook 但根许可未确认，不列开源项目。默认 router 和另段 RBAC/缓存仍用 GPT，不能称为 Jev 授权系统；课程数据另需取得。20题结果与费用为作者自报/估计；未读 notebook 输出、下载语料或调用模型。
boundary.en: Public notebook with unconfirmed root licensing, so no project entry. The default router and separate RBAC/cache section still use GPT, not Jev authorization; course data is external. The 20-question results/costs are author-reported/estimated. No notebook outputs, corpus downloads or model calls.

title.zh: Jev Guide：只标出下一步，由用户自己点击
title.en: Jev Guide: highlight the next step for the user to click

input.zh: 用户目标、页面可点击元素与已尝试路径；候选很多时先分批缩小。
input.en: A user goal, clickable page elements and attempted paths, with batch shortlisting for large candidate sets.

decision.zh: 原生 TypeSafe 接线以 Choice 选元素，Noul 判断目标完成、登录需要及不可逆/目标匹配；大页用 Score 预筛。
decision.en: Native TypeSafe wiring uses Choice for the element and Nouls for completion, login needs, irreversibility and goal match; large pages use Score shortlisting.

action.zh: 只绘制高亮、低置信备选和最终步骤警告；点击、输入和提交均由用户完成，过期页面答案丢弃。
action.en: It draws highlights, uncertain alternatives and final-step warnings; the user clicks, types and submits, and stale-page answers are discarded.

boundary.zh: 阶段4/7的公开代码，根/package许可未发现，不列开源项目。演示为合成fixture，含错误转向；高置信与红色警告不保证正确或安全。OpenRouter兼容未核，只确认原生接线。未安装扩展、扩大权限、改密码或取消真实订阅。
boundary.en: Stage-4/7 public code without confirmed root/package licensing, so no project entry. Synthetic fixtures include wrong turns; confidence and red warnings guarantee neither correctness nor safety. Only native wiring was reviewed, not OpenRouter compatibility. No extension installation, permission expansion, password changes or real cancellations.

title.zh: Feather Wand：Jev 为 JMeter Agent 选择初始工具包
title.en: Feather Wand: Jev selects the JMeter agent’s initial tool pack

input.zh: 去除附件正文后的请求文本，路由视图最多4000字符；仍可能含用户自行写入的敏感内容。
input.en: A request with attachment bodies removed and the routing view capped at 4,000 characters; user-entered sensitive text can remain.

decision.zh: 原生 Jev Choice 选择检查解释、编辑计划、运行诊断、关联、计划文件，或复杂/不清楚；代码校验标签与概率。
decision.en: Native Jev Choice selects inspection, plan editing, run/diagnosis, correlation, plan files or complex/unclear, checking labels and probabilities.

action.zh: 达到配置置信门槛时聚焦工具包并显示路由卡；低置信、复杂或服务不可用时回退全工具集，交给后续 Agent。
action.en: A confident route focuses the tool pack and displays a route card; low confidence, complexity or unavailable service falls back to all tools for the downstream agent.

boundary.zh: MIT 社区插件；路由默认关闭，默认门槛0.75，也可选其他决策后端。工具包选择不是授权，改动/运行仍受宿主确认配置影响；未安装 JMeter、发起压测、读日志或调用模型。
boundary.en: MIT community plugin with routing off by default, a default 0.75 gate and alternative backends. Tool-pack selection is not authorization; mutations/runs depend on host confirmation settings. No JMeter installation, load tests, logs or model calls.

title.zh: Lightpanda：让 Jev 选择登录表单的三个控件
title.en: Lightpanda: Jev selects three login-form controls

input.zh: 作者演示中登录页面提供的控件；原帖未公开完整传入字段。
input.en: Controls available on the demo login page; the complete input fields are not disclosed.

decision.zh: 作者称 Jev 选择用户名输入框、密码输入框和提交按钮，从页面现有控件中作有限选择。
decision.en: The author says Jev selects the username field, password field and submit button from existing page controls.

action.zh: Lightpanda 的 Agent 将选出的控件用于登录流程，TypeSafe 转发推荐了该演示。
action.en: Lightpanda’s agent uses the selected controls in the login flow, and TypeSafe recommended the demonstration.

boundary.zh: 仅作者原帖与官方转发，属于 Lightpanda 社区集成。0.53秒/2次调用为作者演示数字，不能外推通用成功率；未精读 jev-fallback 分支、验证题型/失败处理、读取凭据或实际登录，不列已核许可项目。
boundary.en: Author post and official recommendation only, describing a Lightpanda community integration. The 0.53-second/two-call figures are author demo numbers, not a general success rate. No branch, question-type/failure-path, credential or live-login verification; no verified-license project entry.

title.zh: Conversation X-Ray：逐句着色并显示六个情绪维度
title.en: Conversation X-Ray: colored phrases and six emotion meters

input.zh: 演示中的逐句通话内容，画面同时显示实时转写；本轮未向演示发送声音。
input.en: Phrase-by-phrase call content with a live transcript visible in the demo; no voice was submitted this run.

decision.zh: 作者称 Jev 作情绪判断，界面呈现挫败、愉悦、惊讶、不确定、紧迫和中性六个维度；未公开具体题型、尺度与阈值。
decision.en: The author attributes emotion judgments to Jev; the UI shows frustration, happiness, surprise, uncertainty, urgency and neutral, without published question types, scales or thresholds.

action.zh: 话语片段按判断结果着色，右侧量表随通话变化；TypeSafe 当时转发了原作者演示。
action.en: Phrases are color-coded and meters change during the call; TypeSafe recommended the original demonstration.

boundary.zh: 补收9月24日作者原帖与27秒演示，非 TypeSafe 一手项目。未核源码、Jev是否接收声线或数据保留；“不存储”只是作者自报。没有独立准确率/延迟测量，未开启麦克风、调用服务或上传用户通话。
boundary.en: Backfilled from the September 24 author post and 27-second demo, not a TypeSafe-owned project. Source code, whether vocal tone reaches Jev and retention were not verified; no-storage is an author claim. No independent accuracy/latency measurement, microphone access, service calls or user-call uploads.
